book_name: 当代英美外刊地道短语与句子

words.tr: 短语. 在学业上表现出色；在学术方面取得优异成绩
words.ex: He works hard to excel academically.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以在学业上出类拔萃。
words.en: Achieve outstanding results in academic studies.

words.tr: phrase. 学术成功；学业成就
words.ex: He works hard for academic success.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以取得学业上的成功。
words.en: Achievement in educational pursuits, often measured by grades, awards, and the attainment of degrees.

words.tr: phrase. 低教育程度；低学历
words.ex: Many adults have low educational attainment and struggle to find good jobs.
words.ex_cn: 许多成年人教育水平低，难以找到好工作。
words.en: Low educational attainment refers to a lack of formal education or qualifications, often limiting opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 受过良好或高度教育的
words.ex: He is a well educated man who speaks five languages.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个受过良好教育的人，会说五种语言。

words.tr: phrase. 没有受过良好教育
words.ex: He is poorly educated and struggles to read simple books.
words.ex_cn: 他受教育程度低，很难读懂简单的书。
words.en: Poorly educated describes someone who has not received a good or sufficient education.

words.tr: phrase. 学术资格；学历；指一个人在教育机构中获得的学位、证书或文凭等证明其学术水平的资质
words.ex: He has high academic qualifications.
words.ex_cn: 他有很高的学历。
words.en: Academic qualifications refer to the degrees, diplomas, certificates, professional titles, etc., that a person has achieved through formal education or training.

words.tr: phrase. 创造公平竞争环境；使竞争条件平等
words.ex: The new law tries to level a playing field for small and big businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律试图为小企业和大企业创造公平的竞争环境。
words.en: To level a playing field is to make conditions fair and equal for all participants in a competition or situation.

words.w: create or ensure a level playing field
words.tr: phrase. 创造或确保公平的竞争环境
words.ex: The government wants to create a level playing field for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为中小企业创造一个公平的竞争环境。

words.tr: phrase. 处于平等地位；以平等的条件
words.ex: They are on an equal footing in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他们在比赛中处于平等地位。
words.en: On an equal footing means in a situation where all parties have the same status, rights, or advantages.

words.tr: phrase. 经济条件较好的同龄人或同辈群体
words.ex: The better-off peers bought new laptops for school.
words.ex_cn: 条件更好的同龄人为学校买了新笔记本电脑。
words.en: The better-off peers are people who are more financially or socially advantaged than others in a group.

words.tr: phrase. 他们的同龄人；他们的同辈
words.ex: They compare their grades with their peers.
words.ex_cn: 他们把自己的成绩和他们的同龄人比较。

words.tr: phrase. 给某人配备某物；使某人具备某物
words.ex: The school equips students with laptops.
words.ex_cn: 学校给学生配备笔记本电脑。

words.tr: adj. 设备齐全的
words.ex: The lab is well-equipped with modern tools.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验室配备了现代化的工具。
words.en: Having all the necessary equipment or features for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 为某人配备所需技能或工具以应对某事
words.ex: The school helps equip students for the real world.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助学生为进入现实世界做好准备。

words.tr: phrase. 将某物灌输于；使某人逐渐接受（某种思想、观念或习惯）
words.ex: Parents should instil good habits in their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该将好习惯灌输给孩子。

words.tr: phrase. 向某人介绍某事物；使某人了解或接触某事物
words.ex: My teacher introduced me to algebra.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师向我介绍了代数。

words.tr: phrase. 为某事打开大门；使某事成为可能
words.ex: This discovery can open the door to new treatments.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现可以为新的治疗方法打开大门。

words.tr: phrase. 为…奠定基础；为…打下根基
words.ex: He laid the foundations for his future success by working hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作为未来的成功打下了基础。
words.en: To establish the basic conditions or principles necessary for future development or success.

words.w: make it possible to do something
words.tr: phrase. 使某事成为可能
words.ex: This new tool makes it possible to finish the work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使更快完成工作成为可能。

words.tr: phrase. 拓宽视野；扩展眼界
words.ex: Traveling to other countries can broaden your horizons.
words.ex_cn: 去其他国家旅行可以拓宽你的视野。

words.tr: 使某人开阔眼界；增长见识
words.ex: Reading books can broaden one's mind.
words.ex_cn: 读书可以开阔一个人的思维。
words.en: To increase one's knowledge, understanding, or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 丰富某人的生活
words.ex: Reading books can enrich one's life.
words.ex_cn: 读书可以丰富一个人的生活。
words.en: To enrich one's life is to make it more fulfilling, interesting, or rewarding through new experiences or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 提升某人的前途；改善某人的前景
words.ex: He studies hard to improve his prospects.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以改善自己的前景。
words.en: To improve one's prospects is to increase the chances of success, advancement, or a better future.

words.tr: phrase. 有前途的未来；充满希望的前景
words.ex: He works hard because he has a promising future.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，因为他有一个光明的未来。
words.en: A future that shows signs of success or potential.

words.tr: phrase. 生活机会；人生机遇；社会地位决定的个人发展可能性
words.ex: Children from poor families have fewer life chances.
words.ex_cn: 来自贫困家庭的孩子拥有更少的生活机会。

words.w: give someone an edge over someone
words.tr: phrase. 给某人相对于另一人的优势
words.ex: Practice gives her an edge over her classmates.
words.ex_cn: 练习让她比同学更有优势。

words.w: get or gain an edge over someone or something
words.tr: phrase. 超越某人或某物；占据优势
words.ex: He trained hard to get an edge over his rival.
words.ex_cn: 他努力训练以超越对手。

words.tr: 短语. 处于有利地位；占有优势
words.ex: He speaks English well, so he is at an advantage.
words.ex_cn: 他英语说得好，所以占优势。
words.en: To be in a more favorable or advantageous situation.

words.w: cultivate or develop a taste for something
words.tr: phrase. 培养对某事物的品味或兴趣
words.ex: Parents should cultivate a taste for reading in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子对阅读的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 对某物有喜好；对某物有品味或兴趣
words.ex: He has a taste for sweet food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢甜食。

words.tr: phrase. 兴趣与爱好；个人喜好与业余活动
words.ex: He likes reading and playing soccer as his interests and hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读和踢足球作为他的兴趣和爱好。
words.en: Activities pursued for enjoyment outside of work or study.

words.tr: phrase. 在某方面的良好基础
words.ex: He has a good grounding in mathematics from his early schooling.
words.ex_cn: 他从小学起就打下了良好的数学基础。

words.tr: phrase. 某事的基本知识；某事的入门常识
words.ex: Learning the abc s of cooking is easy with this book.
words.ex_cn: 通过这本书，学习烹饪的基本知识很容易。

words.tr: phrase. 某事物的基本原理；某事物的基础知识
words.ex: He learned the basics of cooking from his grandmother.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖母那里学到了烹饪的基本原理。

words.tr: phrase. 某事物的基本原理或基础知识
words.ex: He learned the rudiments of math in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 他在小学时学习了数学的基本原理。

words.tr: phrase. 被定制以适应；被裁剪以适合；根据……的需要进行调整
words.ex: The course is tailored to beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程是为初学者量身定制的。
words.en: To be designed or adapted to meet a particular need or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使适合于；以...为目标；调整以适应
phrase. 针对；瞄准；以...为目标
phrase. 教育军备竞赛；指在教育领域中，个人、学校或国家之间为获得竞争优势而不断加大投入、提高标准的竞争现象
words.ex: Parents are in an educational arms race to get their children into top schools.
words.ex_cn: 家长们为了让孩子进入顶尖学校而陷入教育竞争。
words.en: A competitive struggle in education where individuals or institutions continually invest more resources to gain an advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 激烈或强烈的竞争
words.ex: There is fierce competition for the top job.
words.ex_cn: 对这份顶级工作的竞争非常激烈。

words.tr: 短语动词. 攀升教育阶梯，指通过接受更高层次的教育来提升自己的社会地位或职业前景
words.ex: He wants to climb the educational ladder by going to university.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过上大学来提升教育水平。
words.en: Progress through levels of education, typically from primary to tertiary, often with the aim of achieving higher qualifications.

words.tr: phrase. 死记硬背；机械地记忆
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他为了考试死记硬背了这首诗。

words.tr: phrase. 死记硬背式学习；机械学习
words.ex: He hates rote learning because it feels boring.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌死记硬背，因为它感觉很无聊。
words.en: Rote learning is a memorization technique based on repetition.

words.tr: phrase. 熟记；背诵某物到能够脱口而出的程度
words.ex: He learned the poem off by heart for the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他为了比赛把这首诗熟记了下来。

words.tr: phrasal verb. 为……临时抱佛脚；为应付考试而突击学习
words.ex: He is cramming for his math test tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚正在突击准备数学考试。
words.en: Study intensively and rapidly, especially in preparation for an exam, often using last-minute methods.

words.tr: phrase. 参加考试；参加某项考试（如期末考试、资格考试等）
words.ex: He will sit for an examination next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要参加一场考试。
words.en: Take or undergo an examination, typically a formal one for educational or professional purposes.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得进入……的许可；获准进入
words.ex: He needs a ticket to gain admittance to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张票才能进入音乐会。
words.en: Gain entry or acceptance into an institution, organization, or program, often after meeting specific criteria.

words.tr: phrase. 入学要求；准入条件
words.ex: The entry requirement for this school is a high school diploma.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的入学要求是高中文凭。
words.en: The conditions that must be met in order to be admitted into a school, program, or event.

words.w: do well in an exam or test
words.tr: phrase. 在考试或测验中表现良好
words.ex: He studied hard and did well in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，在数学测验中表现良好。

words.tr: phrase. 考试不及格；未通过考试
words.ex: He failed an exam because he didn't study.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没学习而考试不及格。

words.w: scrape through an exam or test
words.tr: phrase. 刚好通过考试或测验；勉强过关
words.ex: He scraped through the math test by just one point.
words.ex_cn: 他勉强以一分之差通过了数学考试。

words.tr: phrase. 在……获得一个位置／席位（如学校、项目、活动等）
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a place at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以获得大学的录取名额。
words.en: Obtain a position or spot in an institution, such as a university or program, often through competition or application.

words.tr: phrase. 学习成果；学习成效；预期达到的学习目标
words.ex: The learning outcomes of this course are clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学习成果清晰而简单。
words.en: The results or achievements that learners are expected to demonstrate after completing a course or program.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: 某事是一个艰苦的过程
phrase. 非常有回报的
words.ex: Teaching can be very rewarding when you see your students succeed.
words.ex_cn: v. 当你看到你的学生成功时，教学可以非常有回报。
words.en: If something is very rewarding, it makes you feel happy and satisfied because you think it is worthwhile or important.

words.tr: phrase. 某人的抱负；某人的志向；某人的渴望
words.ex: Someone's aspiration is to become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 某人的志向是成为一名教师。
words.en: Someone's strong desire to achieve something or to have a particular kind of life.

words.tr: phrase. 集中注意力于某事
words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中注意力于你的作业。

words.tr: phrase. 构成……的基础；作为……的根基
words.ex: This simple rule forms the basis of the math system.
words.ex_cn: 这个简单的规则构成了数学体系的基础。
words.en: To provide the fundamental support or foundation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 运用横向思维；采用非传统或创造性的方式思考问题
words.ex: He used lateral thinking to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用横向思维解决了这个谜题。
words.en: To use lateral thinking means to approach problems or situations from a new or unusual angle, rather than by traditional step-by-step logic.

words.tr: phrase. 依赖线性思维；依靠直线式思考方式
words.ex: Many people rely on linear thinking to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 许多人依赖线性思维来解决问题。
words.en: To depend on a straightforward, step-by-step approach to problem-solving or decision-making.

words.tr: phrase. 打破常规；打破模式
words.ex: She decided to break the mould and start her own business.
words.ex_cn: 她决定打破常规，开始自己的事业。
words.en: To do something differently after it has been done in the same way for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 标准化考试：一种按照统一标准进行设计、组织和评估的考试，旨在对学生的知识、技能和能力进行客观、公正的...
words.ex: The SAT is a widely recognized standardized test for college admissions.
words.ex_cn: SAT是一种广泛认可的大学入学标准化考试。
words.en: A test administered and scored in a consistent, uniform manner to ensure comparability across different test-takers.

words.tr: phrase. 有天赋的
words.ex_cn: v. 她在音乐方面有天赋。
words.en: To have a natural ability or talent.

words.tr: phrase. 死记硬背；机械记忆
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote memorization.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背学会了这首诗。
words.en: Rote memorization refers to the process of learning by repetition, often without understanding the underlying meaning or context.

words.tr: phrase. 牢记；背诵；把某事熟记于心
words.ex: He learned the poem by heart for the school contest.
words.ex_cn: 他为了学校比赛把这首诗背得滚瓜烂熟。
words.en: To memorize something completely, especially a piece of text or music.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛阅读；大量阅读；博览群书
words.ex: He reads extensively to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他广泛阅读以提高英语水平。
words.en: To read a wide range of materials or topics in order to gain knowledge or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 促使（某人）临时抱佛脚；导致突击式死记硬背
words.ex: The upcoming exams can induce cramming among students.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的考试可能会导致学生们临时抱佛脚。
words.en: To encourage or cause someone to study intensively in a short time before an exam.

words.tr: n. 无知；愚昧；
words.ex: His ignorance of the rules caused the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的无知导致了这个错误。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information.

words.tr: phrase. 正直行为的标准
words.ex: He lives by the standard of upright conduct.
words.ex_cn: 他以正直的行为准则为生活准则。
words.en: The level of moral integrity and ethical behavior expected.

words.tr: phrase. 学生的自主性；学生自我管理或自我决策的能力
words.ex: Encouraging students' autonomy can lead to more effective learning.
words.ex_cn: 鼓励学生的自主性可以带来更有效的学习。
words.en: The freedom and independence for students to make their own choices.

words.tr: n. 自律；自我约束
words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 模范；榜样
words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.tr: phrase. 树立一个好榜样；以身作则
words.ex: He sets a good example by arriving on time every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天准时到达，树立了良好的榜样。
words.en: To behave in a way that others should copy.

words.tr: phrase. 达到某人的期望；符合某人的预期
words.ex: He worked hard to meet someone's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到别人的期望。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy what someone anticipates or hopes for.

words.tr: phrase. 未达到某人的期望；未能满足某人的要求
words.ex: He fell short of his parents' expectations because he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没考好，辜负了父母的期望。
words.en: To fail to meet someone's expectations or standards.

words.tr: phrase. 无法保证成功的
words.ex_cn: 即使他努力工作，也不能保证他会成功。
words.en: Success is not certain or assured.

words.tr: 短语动词. 涉及很多内容；走很远的路；在短时间内完成大量工作
words.ex: We cover a lot of ground in our science class.
words.ex_cn: 我们的科学课涵盖了很多内容。
words.en: To cover a lot of ground means to deal with a wide range of topics or areas in a discussion, presentation, or piece of work.

words.tr: phrase. 全面发展，多才多艺
words.ex_cn: 他很全面，因为他既运动又读书。
words.en: To be well-rounded means to have a broad range of abilities and knowledge in various areas, making one versatile and adaptable.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事物的全面覆盖；全方位的报道或涵盖
words.ex: The newspaper provided comprehensive coverage of the election.
words.ex_cn: 这家报纸对选举进行了全面报道。

words.tr: phrase. 自定进度学习；学习者根据自身节奏安排学习进程的教育方式
words.ex: He uses self-paced learning to study math at home.
words.ex_cn: 他使用自主节奏学习在家学习数学。
words.en: Self-paced learning refers to an instructional strategy that allows learners to progress through a course at their own speed, without the constraints of a fixed schedule.

words.tr: phrase. 核心课程；必修课程体系
words.ex: Math and science are part of the core curriculum.
words.ex_cn: 数学和科学是核心课程的一部分。
words.en: A set of basic courses that all students must take to graduate.

words.tr: phrase. 教育的目标；教育的目的
words.ex: The aims of education are to help students learn and grow.
words.ex_cn: 教育的目标是帮助学生学习和成长。
words.en: The objectives or goals that education seeks to achieve, encompassing the development of knowledge, skills, and values in individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 学术成就；学业成绩；教育程度
words.ex: His academic attainment improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业成绩提高了。
words.en: The successful completion of educational goals or qualifications.

words.w: be an expert in a particular part of a subject
words.tr: phrase. 在某一学科的特定领域成为专家
phrase. 课外活动；课程以外的活动（如体育、社团、志愿服务等）
words.ex: He joins extra-curricular activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加课外活动。
words.en: Activities pursued outside the formal academic curriculum, such as sports or clubs.

words.tr: phrase. 促进平等；推动平等
words.ex: The school works to promote equality for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校努力促进所有学生的平等。
words.en: To promote equality means to support or encourage the principle that all people should have equal rights and opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 压制个性；压抑个体性
words.ex: The school's strict rules tend to repress individuality among students.
words.ex_cn: 学校的严格规定往往压制学生的个性。
words.en: To suppress or conceal the unique qualities and expressions of a person.

words.tr: n. 共同教育；男女合校教育
words.ex: The school offers co-education for boys and girls.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为男孩和女孩提供男女合校教育。
words.en: An educational system where male and female students attend the same school or classes.

words.tr: phrase. 单性学校；只招收一种性别的学校
words.ex: He went to a single sex school when he was young.
words.ex_cn: 他小时候上的是单性别学校。

words.tr: phrase. 混合能力班；由不同能力水平学生组成的班级
words.ex: The teacher plans a mixed-ability class for all students.
words.ex_cn: 老师为所有学生安排了一个能力混合的班级。
words.en: A classroom containing students with a wide range of abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 区分某人与其他人；辨别某人与他人之间的不同
words.ex: I can distinguish her from her sister by her smile.
words.ex_cn: 我可以通过她的微笑来区分她和她的妹妹。

words.tr: phrase. 反社会行为；破坏公共秩序的行为，如滋扰、破坏公物或暴力行为
words.ex: He shows anti-social behaviour by ignoring others.
words.ex_cn: 他通过忽视他人表现出反社会行为。
words.en: Anti-social behaviour refers to actions that harm or lack consideration for the well-being of others, often violating social norms and laws.

words.tr: phrase. 表现得体，守规矩
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To act in a polite and appropriate manner, especially in social situations.

words.tr: n. 青春期
words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 对生活的健康看法
words.ex: Maintaining a healthy outlook on life can significantly improve your mental well-being.
words.ex_cn: 保持对生活的健康看法可以显著改善你的心理健康。
words.en: A positive and balanced perspective towards life that contributes to one's physical and mental well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 适应良好的成年人
words.ex: The program aims to help children grow into well-adjusted adults.
words.ex_cn: 该计划旨在帮助儿童成长为适应良好的成年人。
words.en: Adults who are emotionally and socially stable, capable of handling life's challenges effectively and maintaining healthy relationships.

words.tr: phrase. 退学；辍学
words.ex: He dropped out of school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年退学了。
words.en: To leave a school or university before you have finished your studies.

words.tr: phrase. 逃学；旷课
words.ex: He skipped school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天逃学了。
words.en: To deliberately miss school without permission.

words.tr: phrase. 达到法定年龄；到了成年
words.ex: He came of age last year and now he can vote.
words.ex_cn: 他去年成年了，现在可以投票了。
words.en: To reach the age at which one is legally recognized as an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 能说两种语言的；双语的
words.ex_cn: 他会说英语和西班牙语，所以是双语者。
words.en: To be bilingual means to be able to speak two languages fluently.

words.tr: phrase. 单语的；仅用一种语言的
words.ex: She is monolingual and only speaks English.
words.ex_cn: 她是单语的，只会说英语。
words.en: Using or knowing only one language.

words.tr: phrase. 偷懒；懈怠；不认真工作
words.ex: He slack off when the teacher isn't looking.
words.ex_cn: 当老师没注意时，他偷懒。
words.en: To be lazy or to do something with less effort or energy than is required.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 专心致志；努力投入（工作或任务）
words.ex: He applies himself to his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: To devote oneself diligently and persistently to a task or activity.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 破坏性的学生；指在课堂或学校环境中行为扰乱秩序、影响教学的学生
words.ex: The teacher sent disruptive students to the office.
words.ex_cn: 老师把捣乱的学生送到了办公室。
words.en: Students who behave in a way that interrupts lessons and disturbs others.

words.tr: phrase. 不守规矩的学生；难以管教的学生
words.ex: The teacher struggled to control the unruly students in her class.
words.ex_cn: 老师努力控制她班上那些难以管教的学生。
words.en: Students who are difficult to control and behave badly.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （机器、身体部位等）出毛病，行为失常；（孩子）调皮捣蛋
words.ex: My old laptop keeps acting up when I open too many programs.
words.ex_cn: 我的旧笔记本电脑在打开太多程序时就会出毛病。
words.en: to behave badly or function improperly

words.tr: n. 缺乏纪律，无纪律
words.ex: The teacher punished the boy for indiscipline.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为不守纪律惩罚了那个男孩。
words.en: Indiscipline refers to a lack of discipline or control, often leading to chaos or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 满足……的需求；符合……的要求
words.ex: The factory works hard to meet the demand of customers.
words.ex_cn: 工厂努力满足客户的需求。
words.en: To fulfill or satisfy the needs or requirements of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 以某事物为导向；使适应某事物；专为某事物设计
phrase. 向某人告知某事
words.ex: Please inform me about the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 请告诉我会议的时间。

words.tr: phrase. 把理论付诸实践；将理论应用于实际
words.ex: He put theory into practice by building a robot.
words.ex_cn: 他通过制作一个机器人将理论付诸实践。
words.en: To apply theoretical knowledge in a practical or real-world situation.

words.tr: phrase. 第一手经验；直接经验
words.ex: She gained first-hand experience of life in a remote village.
words.ex_cn: 她获得了在偏远村庄生活的直接经验。
words.en: First-hand experience refers to knowledge or experience that is obtained directly, rather than from other people or from books.

words.w: the responsibility for something falls on someone
words.tr: 某人对某事负有责任
words.ex: The responsibility for cleaning the room falls on Tom.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间的责任落在汤姆身上。

words.w: the responsibility for something rests with someone
words.tr: 某事的责任在于某人
words.ex: The responsibility for the mistake rests with the manager.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误的责任在于经理。

words.tr: phrase. 逃避某事的责任；推卸某事的职责
words.ex: He tried to shirk his responsibilities for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃避对这个错误的责任。

words.tr: 动词短语，履行某人的责任；尽某人的义务
words.ex: Every citizen should fulfil one's responsibilities to help the community.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都应履行自己的责任来帮助社区。
words.en: To fulfil one's responsibilities means to carry out or complete the duties or tasks that one is expected to do.

words.w: deny someone the freedom to do something
words.tr: phrase. 剥夺某人做某事的自由
words.ex: The government denied the people the freedom to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 政府剥夺了人民自由发言的自由。

words.tr: phrase. 必修科目；必须学习的课程
words.ex: Math is a compulsory subject in all schools.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学校的必修科目。
words.en: A compulsory subject is a course or area of study that students are required to take as part of their curriculum.

words.tr: phrase. 激发某人对某事的兴趣
words.ex: The teacher told stories to kindle the students' interest in science.
words.ex_cn: 老师讲了故事来激发学生对科学的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 选修科目或课程
words.ex: Students can choose optional subjects or courses based on their interests.
words.ex_cn: 学生可以根据自己的兴趣选择选修科目或课程。

words.w: There is no substitute for someone or something
words.tr: 短语 没有东西能替代某人或某物
words.ex: There is no substitute for a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 没有东西能替代一位好老师。

words.tr: phrase. 远程教育
words.ex: He is doing distance learning at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里进行远程学习。
words.en: Distance learning is a way of studying where tuition is carried out over the internet or by post, so that you do not need to attend a college or university.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.tr: phrase. 折中的办法；适中的状态；令人满意的中间立场
words.ex: She found a happy medium between work and leisure.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休闲之间找到了一个折中的办法。
words.en: A happy medium is a compromise between two extremes that is satisfactory to all parties involved.

words.tr: phrase. 担任某人的导师；指导某人
phrase. 某人的同龄人；某人的同等地位者
words.ex: He talks to someone his peer at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里和同龄人聊天。

words.tr: phrase. 抚养；庇护；提携某人（通常指给予指导和保护）
words.ex: The old teacher took the orphan under his wing.
words.ex_cn: 这位老教师抚养了这个孤儿。

words.tr: phrase. v. 熬夜工作；开夜车
words.ex: He burns the midnight oil to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜完成作业。
words.en: If you burn the midnight oil, you stay up very late in order to study or do some other work.

words.tr: phrase. 集中精力地学习；刻苦攻读
words.ex: He studied intensively for the exam last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周集中精力地为考试学习。
words.en: To study something with great concentration and effort.

words.w: by or in leaps and bounds
words.tr: adv. 以飞跃的方式；迅速地；急剧地
words.ex: The company's profits grew by leaps and bounds last year.
words.ex_cn: 该公司去年的利润以飞跃的方式增长。

words.tr: phrase. 技术进步；科技发展
words.ex: Technological progress has revolutionized the way we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 技术进步已经彻底改变了我们的沟通方式。
words.en: Technological progress refers to the invention of new technologies that improve products and processes.

words.tr: phrase. 技术先进的；科技发达的
words.ex: This city is technologically advanced.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市技术先进。
words.en: having or using the latest and most sophisticated technology

words.tr: phrase. 技术的快速进步
words.ex: Rapid advances in technology help people live better.
words.ex_cn: 技术的迅速发展帮助人们生活得更好。
words.en: quick and significant progress in the development of technology

words.tr: v. 取得进展；迅速前进
words.ex: He is making strides in his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学技能上取得了进展。

words.tr: n. 在某方面取得的重大突破
words.ex: The new vaccine is a major breakthrough in fighting the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新疫苗是在对抗这种疾病方面取得的重大突破。

words.tr: n. 某物的前进；某事物的发展进程
words.ex: The march of technology changes our lives every day.
words.ex_cn: 技术的进步每天都在改变我们的生活。

words.w: have the potential to do something
words.tr: v. 有潜力做某事；有可能做某事
words.ex: He has the potential to become a great scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他有潜力成为一名伟大的科学家。

words.tr: v. 威胁要做某事
words.ex: He threatened to call the police if she didn't leave.
words.ex_cn: 如果她不走，他就威胁要叫警察。

words.tr: v. 承诺做某事
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。

words.tr: phrase. 有希望；有前途；显示出良好的前景
words.ex: This new medicine holds promise for curing the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药对治愈这种疾病有希望。
words.en: To seem likely to develop into something successful or beneficial in the future.

words.w: the promise and perils of something
words.tr: n. 某事物的希望与危险
words.ex: The promise and perils of artificial intelligence are widely discussed.
words.ex_cn: 人工智能的希望与危险被广泛讨论。

words.tr: phrase. 一种新奇的事物；新颖的东西
words.ex: The toy is a novelty for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具对孩子来说是个新奇的东西。
words.en: something new, unusual, or interesting

words.tr: v. 在某种程度上是一种新奇事物；有点儿新鲜感
短语：新鲜感逐渐消失；新奇感褪去
words.ex: The novelty wears off after a few days.
words.ex_cn: 几天后，新鲜感就消失了。
words.en: the initial excitement about something new fades over time

words.tr: n. 某物的首次亮相；某物的首秀
words.ex: The debut of the new phone amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这款新手机的首次亮相让所有人惊叹。

words.w: change something out of all recognition
words.tr: v. 彻底改变某物，使其完全认不出来
words.ex: They changed the old house out of all recognition with new walls and windows.
words.ex_cn: 他们用新墙和新窗户彻底改变了这所老房子，让它完全认不出来了。

words.tr: v. 彻底变革；使革命化；
words.ex: The new technology will revolutionize how we learn.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术将彻底变革我们的学习方式。
words.en: To completely change something, especially in a way that improves it.

words.tr: v. 把某物颠倒过来；使某物完全翻转
words.ex: He turned the box upside down to find the keys.
words.ex_cn: 他把盒子颠倒过来找钥匙。

words.tr: phrase. 并驾齐驱
words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 落后；拖欠
words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.w: lead the way in something or doing something
words.tr: v. 在某事或做某事方面率先引领；带头
words.ex: China leads the way in electric car production.
words.ex_cn: 中国在电动汽车生产方面率先引领。

words.tr: 在...方面领先世界
words.ex: China leads the world in solar energy production.
words.ex_cn: 中国在太阳能生产方面领先世界。

words.tr: v. 在某领域成为先驱；率先开创某事物

words.w: be used for good or ill
words.tr: 短语. 无论结果是好是坏；不管被用于善还是恶的目的
words.uk: biː juːzd fɔː ɡʊd ɔːr ɪl
words.us: bi juːzd fɔːr ɡʊd ɔːr ɪl
words.ex: Power can be used for good or ill.
words.ex_cn: 权力可以用来做好事，也可以用来做坏事。
words.en: To have the potential to be used for positive or negative purposes, depending on the user's intent.

words.tr: phrase. 无论好坏；不管结果是好是坏
words.ex: The decision will affect the company for good or ill.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定将对公司产生积极或消极的影响。
words.en: Used to indicate that something will have a significant effect, whether positive or negative.

words.tr: adj. 最先进的；达到最高水平的
words.ex: This hospital has state-of-the-art equipment.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院拥有最先进的设备。
words.en: The most advanced or sophisticated level of development, as of a device, technique, or scientific field, achieved at a particular time.

words.tr: adj. 前沿的；尖端的
words.ex: This phone has cutting-edge technology.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机拥有尖端技术。
words.en: Something that is cutting-edge is at the forefront of technological or other developments.

words.tr: adv. 在某事物的前沿；处于某事物的领先地位
words.ex: He is at the forefront of renewable energy research.
words.ex_cn: 他在可再生能源研究的前沿。

words.tr: phrase. 处于萌芽阶段；在初创时期；在婴儿期
words.ex: The company is still in its infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司还处于初创阶段。
words.en: In the very early stages of development; not yet fully formed or mature.

words.tr: phrase. 新出现的；新兴的
words.ex: A newly emerging technology is changing our lives.
words.ex_cn: 一种新出现的技术正在改变我们的生活。
words.en: Recently coming into existence or prominence.

words.tr: n. 某物的出现；某事的到来
words.ex: The advent of smartphones changed how we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的出现改变了我们的沟通方式。

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在早期阶段；在初期
words.ex: In the early stages, he felt confused about the project.
words.ex_cn: 在初期，他对这个项目感到困惑。
words.en: During the beginning phase of a process, project, or development.

words.tr: adj. 节省时间的
words.ex: This app is time-saving because it does tasks quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用很节省时间，因为它能快速完成任务。
words.en: adj. designed to or resulting in a reduction in the time needed to do something.

words.tr: adj. 耗时的
words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: phrase. 浪费时间；徒劳无益的事情
words.ex: Playing video games all day is a waste of time.
words.ex_cn: 整天玩电子游戏是浪费时间。
words.en: If you say that something is a waste of time, you mean that it is not worth doing because it will not achieve anything.

words.tr: n. 某物中不可或缺的部分
words.ex: Water is an indispensable part of life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命中不可或缺的部分。

words.w: play a pivotal role in doing something
words.tr: v. 在做某事中起关键作用
words.ex: Clean energy plays a pivotal role in reducing pollution.
words.ex_cn: 清洁能源在减少污染中起关键作用。

words.tr: adj. 对做某事不可或缺的；对某事至关重要的

words.w: eliminate the need for something to do something
words.tr: v. 消除某物做某事的必要性
words.ex: The new app eliminates the need for you to wait in line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新应用消除了你排队的必要性。

words.w: do away with someone or something
words.tr: v. 废除；取消；消除（某人或某物）
words.ex: The government decided to do away with the old law.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定废除旧法律。

words.tr: v. 必须做某事；需要做某事
words.ex: The heavy rain necessitates staying indoors.
words.ex_cn: 大雨必须待在室内。

words.tr: v. 使某物过时；使某物被淘汰
words.ex: Smartphones rendered cameras obsolete.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机使相机过时了。

words.tr: v. 解放某人脱离某物/某种束缚
words.ex: The soldiers helped to liberate the prisoners from the camp.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们帮助解放了那些从营地中被囚禁的人。

words.tr: v. 使某人摆脱某物；解放某人脱离某种束缚或困境
words.ex: The new law freed people from heavy taxes.
words.ex_cn: 新法律使人们摆脱了重税。

words.tr: v. 给某人留出（某物）； spared me some time（给我留出了一些时间）
words.ex: Can you spare me five minutes?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我留出五分钟吗？

words.w: save someone the trouble or bother of doing something
words.tr: v. 省去某人做某事的麻烦或烦恼
words.ex: I'll send you the report to save you the bother of writing it.
words.ex_cn: 我来发给你报告，省得你费心写了。

words.tr: n. 某物的枷锁；某种束缚或限制
words.ex: He broke free from the shackles of fear.
words.ex_cn: 他挣脱了恐惧的枷锁。

words.tr: n. 对某物的即时访问
words.ex: With a password, you get instant access to something.
words.ex_cn: 有了密码，你就可以即时访问某物。

words.w: gain or have access to something
words.tr: v. 获得或接触到某物
words.ex: He gained access to the library after getting a student card.
words.ex_cn: 他拿到学生证后就进入了图书馆。

words.tr: phrase. 变得广泛可用；变得普及并容易获得
words.ex: Solar panels become widely available in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能电池板在许多国家变得广泛可用。
words.en: To become accessible to the general public on a large scale.

words.tr: 短语动词. 被笼罩在秘密之中；被隐瞒；不为外界所知
words.ex: The project is shrouded in secrecy.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目被保密。
words.en: To be hidden or kept secret, often deliberately.

words.tr: phrase. 开创先河；取得突破性进展；开辟新领域
words.ex: The scientist's research breaks new ground in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家的研究在医学上开辟了新领域。
words.en: To do something innovative that has not been done before.

words.tr: phrase. 科学上的重大突破；科学领域的突破性进展
words.ex: The discovery of penicillin was one of the most significant scientific breakthroughs of the 20th century.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现是20世纪最重要的科学突破之一。
words.en: Significant discoveries or advancements in scientific knowledge.

words.tr: v. 取代；替代某物
words.ex: The new software will supersede the old version.
words.ex_cn: 新软件将取代旧版本。

words.tr: v. 热情欢迎某物；张开双臂欢迎
words.ex: They welcomed the new teacher with open arms.
words.ex_cn: 他们热情欢迎这位新老师。

words.tr: v. 使某物普及；推广某物
words.ex: The app helped popularize online learning.
words.ex_cn: 这款应用帮助普及了在线学习。

words.tr: n. 对某物的依赖
words.ex: The country has a strong dependency on oil imports.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家对石油进口有很强的依赖。

words.tr: phrase. 遗传工程；基因工程
words.ex: Scientists use genetic engineering to change plant genes.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用基因工程来改变植物的基因。
words.en: The deliberate modification of the characteristics of an organism by manipulating its genetic material.

words.tr: phrase. 转基因食品；经过基因改造的食品
words.ex: Many people are concerned about the safety of genetically-modified food.
words.ex_cn: 许多人对转基因食品的安全性表示担忧。
words.en: Food derived from organisms whose genetic material has been altered using biotechnology.

words.tr: v. 最小化某事的风险
words.ex: Wear a helmet to minimize the risk of head injury.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以最小化头部受伤的风险。

words.tr: phrase. 云计算
words.ex: He uses cloud computing to store his files.
words.ex_cn: 他使用云计算来存储文件。
words.en: Cloud computing is the delivery of different services through the Internet, including data storage, servers, databases, networking, and software.

words.tr: n. 电讯家庭办公；在家办公；
words.ex: He likes telecommuting because he can work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢电讯家庭办公，因为他可以在家工作。
words.en: Telecommuting refers to the practice of working from home or another remote location, using the internet, email, and the telephone to communicate with the office.

words.tr: phrase. 气象卫星（用于观测和收集地球大气数据的人造卫星）
words.ex: Meteorological satellites provide valuable data for weather forecasting.
words.ex_cn: 气象卫星为天气预报提供了宝贵的数据。
words.en: Satellites used to observe and monitor weather patterns and atmospheric conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 通信设备；通讯器材
words.ex: The school bought new communications equipment for the office.
words.ex_cn: 学校为办公室购买了新的通信设备。
words.en: Devices and systems used for transmitting and receiving information, such as radios or telephones.

words.tr: n. 电话会议；视频会议；
words.ex: We use teleconferencing to talk with our team in another city.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用电话会议与另一个城市的团队交谈。
words.en: Teleconferencing is the use of telecommunication technology to conduct meetings between participants who are in different locations.

words.tr: phrase. 一次载人任务；指有宇航员或人员参与的航天、探险等任务
words.ex: The country successfully launched a manned mission to Mars.
words.ex_cn: 该国成功发射了一次前往火星的载人任务。
words.en: A mission that involves sending humans into space, as opposed to unmanned missions which are carried out by robots or machines.

words.tr: n. 失重；零重力
words.ex: Astronauts experience zero gravity in space.
words.ex_cn: 宇航员在太空中经历失重。

words.tr: n. 宇航员；太空人
words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.tr: v. 用某物做实验；尝试某物
words.ex: He is experimenting with new paint colors.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用新的油漆颜色做实验。

words.tr: phrase. 满足人类的好奇心
words.ex: The telescope helps to satisfy human curiosity about space.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜帮助满足人类对太空的好奇心。
words.en: To fulfill or answer the desire to learn or know about something.

words.tr: phrase. 来之不易的发现；经过艰苦努力才获得的成果
words.ex: He made a hard-won discovery after ten years of research.
words.ex_cn: 经过十年的研究，他做出了一个来之不易的发现。
words.en: A discovery that was achieved with great effort, perseverance, or sacrifice.

words.tr: phrase. 太空竞赛（指20世纪美苏之间为争夺航天技术优势而展开的竞争）
words.ex: The space race began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 太空竞赛始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: The competitive rivalry, especially between nations, to achieve dominance in space exploration and technology.

words.tr: phrase. 社交网络网站；用于人际互动与信息分享的在线平台
words.ex: He uses social networking websites to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他使用社交网站和朋友聊天。
words.en: Websites that allow people to create a public profile and interact with other users on the website.

words.tr: phrase. 与…互动；与…相互作用；与…交流
words.ex: The children interact with each other at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校里互相交流。
words.en: To communicate or engage with someone, often in a social or professional context.

words.tr: phrase. 身份盗窃；冒用他人身份（通过非法获取个人信息以假冒他人进行欺诈等犯罪活动）
words.ex: He lost money because of identity theft.
words.ex_cn: 他因为身份盗窃而损失了钱。
words.en: The fraudulent use of another person's personal information for financial gain or other illegal purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件欺诈；通过电子邮件进行的诈骗行为
words.ex: He lost money because of e-mail fraud.
words.ex_cn: 他因为电子邮件诈骗而损失了钱。
words.en: The use of electronic mail to deceive or defraud individuals, often for financial gain.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件垃圾邮件发送；指大量发送未经请求的电子邮件的行为
words.ex: E-mail spamming is a common problem for internet users.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾邮件发送是互联网用户常见的问题。
words.en: The unsolicited sending of large numbers of emails, typically for advertising or malicious purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 人工智能
words.ex: He is learning artificial intelligence at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习人工智能。
words.en: Artificial intelligence refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines that are programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.

words.tr: n. 一种高科技小装置
words.ex: He bought a high-tech gizmo to clean his room automatically.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个高科技小装置来自动打扫房间。
words.en: A small, clever, and often expensive technological device.

words.tr: n. 超导体；超导电体
words.ex: The superconductor carries electricity without losing energy.
words.ex_cn: 超导体在传输电力时不会损失能量。
words.en: A superconductor is a material that can conduct electricity without resistance when it is cooled below a certain temperature.

words.tr: adj. 超音速的
words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.tr: v. 被机械化；实现机械化
phrase. 大量生产；批量生产
words.ex: The factory uses mass production to make cars quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用大规模生产来快速制造汽车。
words.en: Mass production is the manufacture of large quantities of standardized products, often using assembly lines or automated technology.

words.tr: phrase. 硅谷（美国加利福尼亚州的一个地区，以高科技产业和创新公司聚集闻名）
words.ex: He works in Silicon Valley as a software engineer.
words.ex_cn: 他在硅谷做软件工程师。
words.en: A region in California, USA, known for its high technology industry and innovation.

words.tr: phrase. 信息高速公路（指互联网或高速数据通信网络）
words.ex: The information highway connects people all over the world.
words.ex_cn: 信息高速公路连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: A metaphor for the internet and the global network of information and communication technologies.

words.w: speed up the pace of something
words.tr: v. 加快某事的进程
words.ex: The new policy will speed up the pace of economic growth.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策将加快经济增长的进程。

words.tr: phrase. 设定优先事项；确定优先顺序
words.ex: You need to set priorities to manage your time effectively.
words.ex_cn: 你需要设定优先级来有效管理你的时间。
words.en: To decide which tasks or problems are more important and deal with them first.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟现实
words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.tr: adj. 高清的
words.ex: He watches movies in high-definition on his TV.
words.ex_cn: 他用电视以高清观看电影。
words.en: High-definition refers to a very detailed and clear image or sound, especially in television and video.

words.tr: v. 从某事物中带来解放
words.ex: The new law will bring liberation from unfair taxes.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将带来从不公平税收中的解放。

words.tr: n. 自动化
words.ex: The factory uses automation to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用自动化来制造汽车。
words.en: The use of largely automatic equipment in a system of manufacturing or other production process.

words.tr: phrase. 提高农作物产量
words.ex: Farmers are adopting new technologies to boost crop yield.
words.ex_cn: 农民们正在采用新技术以提高作物产量。
words.en: To increase the agricultural output of a specific crop through improved methods or technology.

words.tr: phrase. 可以想象的是；可以想到的是
words.ex: It is conceivable that he will pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 可以想象他会通过考试。
words.en: It is possible or believable that.

words.tr: phrase. 实现…尚未开发的潜力；发掘…未利用的潜能
words.ex: He realizes the untapped potential of the old machine.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到这台旧机器未被开发的潜力。
words.en: to recognize and make use of abilities that have not been used before

words.w: Some scientific evidence has emerged to the contrary
words.tr: 短语。一些科学证据已经出现，与先前观点相反
words.uk: sʌm ˈsaɪəntɪfɪk ˈevɪdəns hæz ɪˈmɜːdʒd tu ðə ˈkɒntrəri
words.us: sʌm ˈsaɪəntɪfɪk ˈɛvɪdəns hæz ɪˈmɜːrdʒ tə ðə ˈkɑːntrəri
words.ex: Some scientific evidence has emerged to the contrary.
words.ex_cn: 一些科学证据反而出现了。
words.en: Evidence has been found that contradicts a previous claim or belief.

words.w: There is considerable evidence suggesting that
words.tr: 有大量证据表明
words.uk: ðeə ɪz ˈkɒnsɪdərəbəl ˈevɪdəns sɪɡnɪfɪŋ ðæt
words.us: ðer ɪz ˈkɑːnsədərəbəl ˈevɪdəns ˈsɪɡnɪfɪŋ ðæt
words.ex: There is considerable evidence suggesting that smoking causes lung cancer.
words.ex_cn: 有大量证据表明吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: There is a substantial amount of evidence that indicates.

words.tr: 短语动词. 转向数字化；采用数字技术
words.ex: The school will go digital next year.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校明年将实现数字化。
words.en: To adopt digital technology or processes, especially in business or services.

words.tr: phrase. 将业务、活动或服务转移到互联网上；上线；数字化迁移
words.ex: The school will move online next week.
words.ex_cn: 学校下周将转为线上教学。
words.en: To shift operations or activities to the internet or online platforms.

words.tr: n. [计] 数字化，数位化，数码化
words.ex: The library is doing digitization of old books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆正在对旧书进行数字化。
words.en: The process of converting information into a digital format that can be processed by a computer.

words.tr: adj. 实体的、现实世界存在的
words.ex: The company is expanding its bricks-and-mortar stores to reach more customers.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在扩展其实体店，以接触更多客户。
words.en: Bricks-and-mortar refers to a traditional business that operates from a physical location, as opposed to an online or virtual business.

words.tr: phrase. 走红；迅速传播（尤指在互联网上）
words.ex: The video went viral on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频在社交媒体上迅速走红。
words.en: If a video, image, or story goes viral, it spreads quickly and widely on the internet through social media and email.

words.tr: phrase. 非常流行；风靡一时
words.en: Be all the rage: To be extremely popular or fashionable for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 成为网络爆红现象；在网络上迅速走红并引起广泛关注
words.ex: She became an internet sensation after posting a funny dance video.
words.ex_cn: 她在发布了一个搞笑的舞蹈视频后成了网络红人。
words.en: To gain widespread popularity and attention online.

words.tr: 短语动词. 成为家喻户晓的名字；变得广为人知
words.ex: The singer became a household name after her hit song.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在推出热门歌曲后变得家喻户晓。
words.en: To become widely known and recognized by the general public.

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐被遗忘；从记忆中淡去
words.ex: His name will fade from memory over time.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字会随着时间的推移被人遗忘。
words.en: Gradually be forgotten or become less vivid in one's mind.

words.tr: n. 网红；网络名人
words.ex: She became an online or internet celebrity after posting funny videos.
words.ex_cn: 她在发布搞笑视频后成为了网红。

words.tr: v. 保持对某事的了解；紧跟某事的最新进展
words.ex: She reads news every day to keep abreast of global events.
words.ex_cn: 她每天读新闻以了解全球动态。

words.tr: phrase. 通知；了解
words.ex: I want to be informed about the news every day.
words.ex_cn: 我想每天了解新闻。
words.en: To have knowledge or information about something.

words.tr: v. 随时掌握某事；对某事了如指掌
words.ex: With the app, you have all the rules at your fingertips.
words.ex_cn: 有了这个应用，你随时都能掌握所有规则。

words.tr: phrase. 没有界限；不受限制；无边无际
words.ex: Love knows no boundaries.
words.ex_cn: 爱没有界限。
words.en: Be limitless or unrestricted in scope or extent.

words.tr: v. 使某人摆脱限制
words.ex: The new law helps to free people from unfair constraints.
words.ex_cn: 新法律帮助人们摆脱不公正的限制。

words.tr: v. 超越障碍或界限
words.ex: She transcends barriers with her courage and wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 她以勇气和智慧超越了障碍。

words.tr: phrase. 悄悄进入；逐渐渗入；不知不觉地出现
words.ex: He tried to creep into the room without waking anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他试图悄悄溜进房间而不吵醒任何人。
words.en: To gradually enter or become noticeable in a situation, often in a way that is not immediately obvious.

words.tr: phrase. 穿透；渗入；刺入；深入；洞察
words.ex: The light penetrates into the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 光线照进了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To enter or gain access to a new market, area, or group.

words.tr: adj. 遍布的；弥漫的；
words.ex: The smell of flowers was pervasive in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 花的香味遍布整个花园。
words.en: Something that is pervasive is present or noticeable throughout a place or thing.

words.tr: n. 某物的无处不在；普遍存在
words.ex: The ubiquity of smartphones makes life easier.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的无处不在让生活更方便。

words.tr: phrase. 数字世界；指由计算机、互联网和数字技术构成的虚拟环境
words.ex: In the digital world, information travels at the speed of light.
words.ex_cn: 在数字世界中，信息以光速传播。
words.en: The digital world refers to the environment created by digital technology, where information is stored, processed, and transmitted in digital form.

words.tr: phrase. 虚拟世界；指由计算机技术构建的模拟环境或数字空间
words.ex: He plays games in the virtual world.
words.ex_cn: 他在虚拟世界里玩游戏。
words.en: The digital realm or environment that exists online.

words.tr: n. 网络空间
words.ex: He spends hours in cyberspace every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在虚拟空间里花几个小时。
words.en: Cyberspace is the notional environment in which communication over computer networks occurs.

words.w: stay or keep in touch with someone
words.tr: v. 与某人保持联系
words.ex: I stay in touch with my old friend by texting every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周发短信与我的老朋友保持联系。

words.w: remain or stay or keep in contact with someone
words.tr: v. 与某人保持联系
words.ex: I remain in contact with my old teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我与我的老老师保持联系。

words.tr: v. 与某人建立深厚关系；与某人产生情感联系
words.ex: They bonded with each other during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中建立了深厚的关系。

words.tr: phrase. 面对面交流；直接沟通
words.ex: They prefer face-to-face communication over texting.
words.ex_cn: 他们更喜欢面对面交流而不是发短信。
words.en: Communication that occurs directly between individuals, without the use of a medium, allowing for immediate feedback and personal interaction.

words.tr: phrase. 社交圈；交际圈
words.ex: He joined a new social circle after moving to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到城市后加入了一个新的社交圈。
words.en: A group of people who regularly interact socially.

words.tr: phrase. 朋友圈；友人圈
words.ex: He talks only to his circle of friends.
words.ex_cn: 他只和他的朋友圈交谈。
words.en: A group of people who are friends with each other, especially one that someone spends a lot of time with.

words.tr: phrase. 社交网络
words.ex: Social networks have changed the way we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 社交网络改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: Social networks are platforms that allow people to connect and share information with others online.

words.tr: n. 对某物的大量使用
words.ex: There is heavy use of plastic in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这个工厂对塑料有大量使用。

words.tr: n. 某物的重度使用者
words.ex: Heavy users of smartphones often check them every few minutes.
words.ex_cn: 智能手机的重度使用者经常每隔几分钟就查看一次。

words.tr: n. 对某物的适度使用
words.ex: Moderate use of sugar is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 对糖的适度使用对健康有益。

words.tr: phrase. 形容人全神贯注地盯着屏幕，无法移开视线
words.ex: The child is glued to the screen during cartoons.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在看卡通时目不转睛地盯着屏幕。
words.en: To be completely engrossed in watching a television, computer, or mobile device.

words.tr: adj. 对屏幕着迷的；沉迷于电子屏幕的
words.ex: The children are screen-obsessed and play games all day.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子沉迷于屏幕，整天玩游戏。
words.en: Excessively focused on or addicted to screens (e.g., phones, computers).

words.tr: phrase. 网络成瘾者；网瘾者
words.ex: He is an internet addict who checks his phone all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是个网络成瘾者，整天都在看手机。
words.en: A person who is compulsively addicted to using the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；对…上瘾
words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: phrase. 沉浸于……中；全神贯注于……
words.ex: He is immersed in reading a novel.
words.ex_cn: 他沉浸在一本书的阅读中。
words.en: To be completely involved in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 一种痴迷；一种无法摆脱的执念
words.ex: He has an obsession with chess.
words.ex_cn: 他对国际象棋着迷。
words.en: An idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.tr: adv. 在聚光灯下；备受关注
words.ex: The actor is in or under the spotlight during the award show.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在颁奖典礼上处于聚光灯下。

words.w: put or turn the spotlight on something
words.tr: v. 把注意力集中在某事物上；使某事物成为焦点
words.ex: The news put the spotlight on pollution in the river.
words.ex_cn: 新闻把注意力集中在河流的污染问题上。

words.tr: n. 公众对某事的关切
words.ex: There is growing public concern over air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 公众对空气污染的关切日益增加。

words.tr: v. 吸引……的注意
words.ex: The bright colors capture the attention of children.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色吸引了孩子们的注意。

words.tr: adj. （言语或行为）吸引公众注意的
words.ex: The poster is attention-grabbing and colorful.
words.ex_cn: 这个海报很吸引眼球，颜色鲜艳。
words.en: Designed to attract attention; striking or noticeable.

words.tr: phrase. 数字鸿沟；指在信息技术的获取和使用方面存在的差距，通常体现在不同社会群体、地区或国家之间
words.ex: The digital divide makes it hard for poor families to use the internet.
words.ex_cn: 数字鸿沟使贫困家庭难以使用互联网。
words.en: The gap between those who have easy access to computers and the internet, and those who do not.

words.tr: phrase. 在数字技术使用方面处于不利地位的；缺乏获取或有效使用数字设备和互联网资源机会的
words.ex: He is digitally disadvantaged and cannot use the online system.
words.ex_cn: 他处于数字劣势，无法使用在线系统。
words.en: Lacking access to or proficiency with digital technology, placing individuals or groups at a social or economic disadvantage.

words.tr: phrase. 具备数字素养的；能够熟练使用数字技术的
words.ex: He is digitally literate and can use computers well.
words.ex_cn: 他懂数字技术，能很好地使用电脑。
words.en: Having the skills to use digital technology effectively and critically.

words.tr: v. 缩小差距；弥合分歧
words.ex: The new policy helps close the divide between rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策有助于缩小贫富差距。

words.tr: phrase. 数字素养；理解、使用和有效操作数字技术的能力
words.ex: Improving digital literacy is crucial for the workforce of the future.
words.ex_cn: 提高数字素养对于未来的劳动力至关重要。
words.en: The ability to effectively and critically navigate, evaluate, and create information using a range of digital technologies.

words.tr: phrase. 被不断攻击或充斥着某物；持续不断地接收到大量信息、批评或请求等
words.ex: He is bombarded with emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都被邮件淹没。
words.en: To be subjected to a continuous flow of questions, information, or other forms of communication, often in a way that is overwhelming or difficult to manage.

words.tr: phrase. 被大量事物淹没；充斥着…；收到过多的（信件、请求等）
words.ex: He is inundated with emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都被邮件淹没。
words.en: To be overwhelmed with a large amount of something, typically more than one can handle.

words.tr: phrase. 被……压垮；充满……（情感）；因……而不知所措
words.ex: He is overwhelmed with homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都被作业压得喘不过气。
words.en: To be so affected by something that you feel unable to deal with it.

words.tr: 短语动词. 抢占头条；吸引公众注意
words.ex: He quickly grab the headline from the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速从报纸上抓住了标题。
words.en: To become the main news story, especially in newspapers or other media.

words.tr: phrase. 主导新闻头条；成为新闻报道的主要内容
words.ex: The scandal dominates the headlines today.
words.ex_cn: 这个丑闻今天占据了头条新闻。
words.en: To be the main focus of news coverage, often repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 突发新闻；最新报道
words.ex: The TV showed breaking news about a big storm.
words.ex_cn: 电视播出了关于一场大风暴的突发新闻。
words.en: Recently received information about events that are currently occurring or have just occurred.

words.tr: phrase. 弹出式广告窗口；网页中自动弹出的小广告框
words.ex: The website showed many pop-up advertising windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个网站显示了许多弹出式广告窗口。
words.en: Pop-up advertising windows are small, unsolicited browser windows that appear suddenly to display advertisements.

words.tr: phrase. 广告时段；广告位
words.ex: The company bought the advertising slot during the prime time to promote its new product.
words.ex_cn: 该公司购买了黄金时段的广告时段来推广其新产品。
words.en: A specific time or space allocated for advertising purposes, especially in broadcasting or online media.

words.tr: 被广泛地、高强度地宣传或广告推广
words.ex: The new product will be intensively advertised to ensure its success in the market.
words.ex_cn: 新产品将被密集地广告宣传，以确保其在市场上的成功。
words.en: Heavily promoted through concentrated marketing efforts.

words.tr: phrase. 广告宣传活动
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: A planned series of advertisements intended to achieve a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 高峰时间
words.ex: The bus is crowded during peak time.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰期，公交车很拥挤。
words.en: The period during which the highest levels of activity or demand occur.

words.tr: n. 收视率; 等级( rating的名词复数 ); 表示电影分级的数字（或字母）; （海军）水兵
words.ex: The TV show's ratings have been steadily declining.
words.ex_cn: 这个电视节目的收视率一直在稳步下降。
words.en: Ratings are evaluations or assessments of the quality or performance of something, often expressed in a numerical or grade form.

words.tr: v. 紧盯着某物；全神贯注于某事
adj. 信息灵通的；了解情况的
phrase. 破坏某人的兴致或乐趣
words.ex: Don't spoil someone's enjoyment by complaining all the time.
words.ex_cn: 不要一直抱怨，破坏别人的乐趣。
words.en: To spoil someone's enjoyment means to reduce or destroy the pleasure or happiness that someone gets from something.

words.tr: v. 激发某人的欲望去做
words.ex: The teacher's story aroused the students' desire to learn more.
words.ex_cn: 老师的故事激发了学生们想要了解更多的好奇心。

words.tr: phrase. 老生常谈的主题；被过度使用而显得陈旧的题材
words.ex: The movie uses well-worn themes like love and betrayal.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影使用了诸如爱情和背叛这样的老套主题。
words.en: Overused ideas or topics that have lost their original impact.

words.tr: phrase. 陈腐的题材；老生常谈的主题
words.ex: The novel avoids hackneyed subjects and instead explores new themes.
words.ex_cn: 这部小说避免了陈腐的主题，而是探索了新的主题。
words.en: Clichéd or unoriginal subjects that lack freshness.

words.tr: phrase. 时事；当前发生的重大事件
words.ex: He reads the newspaper to learn about current affairs.
words.ex_cn: 他读报纸来了解时事。
words.en: Current affairs are events of political or social importance and interest happening in the world at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 媒体炒作；媒体大肆宣传
words.ex: The media hype made the movie seem more exciting than it was.
words.ex_cn: 媒体的炒作让这部电影看起来比实际更精彩。
words.en: Excessive publicity and the ensuing commotion, especially in the media, about something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 有新闻价值的事件；值得报道的事件
words.ex: The fire was a newsworthy event.
words.ex_cn: 这场火灾是一起值得报道的事件。
words.en: An event considered important enough to be reported by news media.

words.tr: phrase. 歪曲事实；篡改真相
words.ex: He tried to distort the truth to avoid punishment.
words.ex_cn: 他试图歪曲事实以避免惩罚。
words.en: To distort the truth means to misrepresent or alter the facts in a way that is misleading or false.

words.tr: phrase. 公正的；无偏见的；不偏不倚的
words.ex: The judge must be unbiased when deciding the case.
words.ex_cn: 法官在裁决案件时必须公正无私。
words.en: To treat all sides or opinions equally, without prejudice.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.tr: n. 审查；审查制度；
words.ex: The government imposed censorship on the news.
words.ex_cn: 政府对新闻实施了审查。
words.en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 公众人物；知名人士
words.ex: Public figures often face media attention.
words.ex_cn: 公众人物经常面临媒体的关注。
words.en: Public figures are individuals who have a certain degree of fame and influence in society, often due to their profession, achievements, or public roles.

words.tr: phrase. 法庭媒体曝光；指法院案件通过媒体向公众传播和报道的现象
words.ex: The celebrity sought to avoid court media publicity after the trial.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人试图在审判后避免法庭媒体曝光。
words.en: The coverage and reporting of court proceedings by the media, aimed at informing the public but sometimes influencing perceptions and outcomes.

words.tr: phrase. 保持低调；不引人注目
words.ex: In order to avoid unwanted attention, he decided to keep a low profile.
words.ex_cn: 为了避免不必要的关注，他决定保持低调。
words.en: To avoid attracting attention or publicity; to stay out of the public eye.

words.tr: phrase. 富有魅力的；迷人的 n. 名人；名流
words.ex: She became a glamorous celebrity overnight after her performance.
words.ex_cn: 她的表演后一夜之间成为了一位富有魅力的名人。
words.en: A glamorous celebrity refers to a famous person who is very attractive and charming, often associated with the entertainment industry.

words.tr: v. 夸大某事；过分渲染某事
words.ex: He exaggerates something when he says he ran ten miles every day.
words.ex_cn: 当他声称自己每天跑十英里时，他在夸大某事。

words.tr: v. 夸大某事；把某事说得过分严重
words.ex: Don't blow that small mistake out of proportion.
words.ex_cn: 别把那个小错误夸大了。

words.tr: v. 错误地描述某事；歪曲某事
words.ex: He misrepresents the facts to win the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他错误地描述事实以赢得争论。

words.tr: phrase. 逃避现实；摆脱现实生活的压力或困扰
words.ex: He watches movies to escape reality.
words.ex_cn: 他看电影来逃避现实。
words.en: To escape reality means to avoid facing the real world, often by engaging in activities that provide a distraction from real-life problems or responsibilities.

words.tr: phrase. 真人秀；纪实节目；真实秀
words.ex: The reality show became a hit overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这档真人秀节目一夜之间就火了。
words.en: A reality show is a type of television program that documents unscripted real-life situations, often featuring ordinary people instead of professional actors.

words.tr: phrase. 智力竞赛节目；问答节目
words.ex: The quiz show was a hit, attracting millions of viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这个问答节目很受欢迎，吸引了数百万观众。
words.en: A quiz show is a television or radio program in which people compete to answer questions correctly.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr: n. 电影术；电影摄影学
words.ex: The film's cinematography is beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的摄影非常美丽。
words.en: The art or technique of movie photography, including both the shooting and development of the film.

words.tr: phrase. 职业生涯；工作年限；一个人从事工作的整个时期
words.ex: He started his working life as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业生涯始于当老师。
words.en: The period of one's life spent in employment, typically from early adulthood to retirement.

words.tr: phrase. 职业生活；职业生涯；职场生涯
words.ex: He works hard to succeed in his professional life.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以在职业生涯中取得成功。
words.en: The period of time spent in a job or profession, especially as a paid occupation.

words.tr: phrase. 来自各行各业的；来自不同社会背景的
words.ex: The conference attracted people from all walks of life.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议吸引了来自各行各业的人们。
words.en: If you refer to people from all walks of life, you are referring to people of all kinds of social backgrounds, professions, or other groups in society.

words.tr: phrase. 来自各行各业；来自各种职业和行业
words.ex: People from all trades and professions came to the fair.
words.ex_cn: 来自各种行业和职业的人都来参加了集市。
words.en: From all types of jobs and occupations.

words.tr: phrase. 达到工作与生活的平衡
words.ex: It's important to strike a work-life balance to avoid burnout.
words.ex_cn: v. 达到工作与生活的平衡以避免精疲力竭。
words.en: To manage one's time and energy between work and personal life in a way that reduces stress and increases well-being.

words.w: blur the line or boundary between work and family life
words.tr: v. 模糊工作与家庭生活之间的界限
words.ex: Working from home can blur the line between work and family life.
words.ex_cn: 在家工作会模糊工作与家庭生活之间的界限。

words.w: juggle or reconcile work with life
words.tr: v. 平衡工作与生活；协调工作与个人生活
words.ex: She tries to juggle work with life by leaving the office early on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 她通过周五早点下班来平衡工作与生活。

words.tr: phrase. 追求事业；从事某一职业
words.ex: He wants to pursue a career as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他想成为一名教师。
words.en: To follow or engage in a particular profession or occupation as a career.

words.w: carve out a career as or in something
words.tr: v. 在某领域开创事业；在某方面建立职业生涯
words.ex: He carved out a career as a musician.
words.ex_cn: 他开创了音乐家的职业生涯。

words.tr: phrase. 找到自己作为……的合适位置；找到自己在某领域中的专长或定位
words.ex: He found his niche as a teacher after years of trying different jobs.
words.ex_cn: 他在尝试了多种工作后，找到了作为教师的专长。
words.en: A verb phrase meaning to discover and establish oneself in a suitable role or area of expertise.

words.tr: phrase. 职业发展；职业生涯的成长与进步
words.ex: He is focusing on career development after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后专注于职业发展。
words.en: Career development refers to the lifelong process of managing learning, work, leisure, and transitions in order to move toward a personally determined and evolving preferred future.

words.w: at the height of someone's career
words.tr: n. 某人事业的巅峰时期
words.ex: He won his first Oscar at the height of his career.
words.ex_cn: 他在事业的巅峰时期赢得了第一个奥斯卡奖。

words.tr: 短语动词. 攀升公司职位阶梯；在职场中逐步晋升
words.ex: He works hard every day to climb the corporate ladder.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力工作以在公司里步步高升。
words.en: To progress in one's career within a company or organization, typically by gaining promotions and moving up to higher positions of responsibility and authority.

words.tr: phrase. 职业发展；事业晋升
words.ex: She is focused on her career advancement within the company.
words.ex_cn: 她专注于在公司内部的职业发展。
words.en: The progress and improvement in one's career, often involving promotions, increased responsibilities, and higher salaries.

words.tr: phrase. 攀升经济阶梯；改善经济地位，指通过努力提高个人或家庭的社会经济地位
words.ex: He works hard to climb the economic ladder.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以提升经济地位。
words.en: To improve one's financial or social status through effort and advancement.

words.tr: phrase. 学会基本技能；掌握窍门；熟悉操作流程
words.ex: He is learning the ropes at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在新工作中学习基本技能。
words.en: To learn the basic skills and procedures needed for a particular job or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 在职培训；岗位培训；边工作边进行的培训
words.ex: He is getting on-the-job training at a car factory.
words.ex_cn: 他正在汽车工厂接受在职培训。
words.en: Training that is given to an employee at their place of work while they are doing the job.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr: phrase. 一份体面的工作；一份待遇和条件都不错的工作
words.ex: He wants a decent job to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一份体面的工作来养家。
words.en: A job that is considered satisfactory in terms of pay, conditions, and respectability.

words.tr: phrase. 一份稳定的工作
words.ex: She was grateful to have finally found a stable job after years of unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 在经历了多年的失业后，她很感激终于找到了一份稳定的工作。
words.en: A job that is secure and unlikely to change or end suddenly.

words.tr: n. 高薪工作
words.ex: He got a high-paying job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司找到了一份高薪工作。

words.tr: phrase. 一份没有晋升机会的工作；没有前途的职业
words.ex: He felt stuck in a dead-end job with no chance of promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己被困在一个没有晋升机会的工作中。
words.en: A dead-end job is a job that offers little or no opportunity for advancement or promotion.

words.tr: phrase. 体力劳动者；从事手工劳动的工人
words.ex: Manual workers often use their hands to build things.
words.ex_cn: 体力劳动者经常用手建造东西。
words.en: Manual workers are people who perform physical labor, often in industries such as construction, manufacturing, and agriculture. Their work typically requires physical strength and endurance.

words.tr: adj. 低技能的
words.ex: He took a low-skill ed job to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他找了一份低技能的工作来赚钱。

words.tr: adj. 白领阶层的；脑力劳动的
words.ex: He works as a white-collar worker in an office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做白领工作。
words.en: Relating to the work done or the people who work in an office or other professional environment.

words.tr: phrase. 以兼职的方式；按部分时间工作地
words.ex: He works on a part-time basis at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆兼职工作。
words.en: Working for a limited number of hours per week, not full-time.

words.tr: phrase. 从事兼职工作；做非全职工作
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: To be employed for a shorter number of hours per week than a full-time job.

words.tr: phrase. 以全职的方式；全职地
words.ex: He works on a full-time basis at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行全职工作。
words.en: Working the standard or full number of hours per week.

words.tr: phrase. 以临时或随意的方式；非正式地；不定期地
words.ex: He plays basketball on a casual basis.
words.ex_cn: 他平时偶尔打篮球。
words.en: Working in an irregular or non-permanent arrangement.

words.w: be or stay chained to one's desk
words.tr: v. 被束缚在办公桌前；长时间被迫坐在办公桌前工作
phrase. 不分昼夜地工作；连续不停地工作
words.ex: The nurses work around the clock to care for patients.
words.ex_cn: 护士们日夜不停地照顾病人。
words.en: Working continuously, day and night, without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 加班；超时工作
words.ex: He works overtime to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他加班赚更多钱。
words.en: To work beyond the regular working hours, often to complete tasks or meet deadlines.

words.tr: n. 过多或繁重的工作量
words.ex: He quit his job because of excessive workload.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作量过多而辞职了。

words.tr: phrase. 朝九晚五的工作时间安排
words.ex: He works a nine-to-five schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天朝九晚五上班。
words.en: A standard work schedule from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., typically associated with office jobs.

words.tr: n. 低收入者或高收入者
words.ex: He is a high earner who works in finance.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名在金融行业工作的高收入者。

words.w: people on low or high incomes
words.tr: n. 收入低或收入高的人群
words.ex: People on low or high incomes pay different taxes.
words.ex_cn: 收入低或收入高的人群缴纳不同的税。

words.tr: adj. 低收入的
words.ex: He comes from a low-income family.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个低收入家庭。
words.en: Low-income refers to individuals or families earning a minimal amount of money, often below a certain threshold that is considered necessary for a basic standard of living.

words.tr: phrase. 收入差距
words.ex: The income gap between the rich and the poor is widening.
words.ex_cn: n. 富人和穷人之间的收入差距正在扩大。
words.en: The difference in income between different groups or individuals, often referring to the disparity between the wealthy and the poor.

words.tr: 远程工作：员工在家中或其他不是组织通常办公地点的地方工作的做法。
words.ex: He likes remote working because he can stay at home.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢远程工作，因为他可以待在家里。
words.en: Remote working refers to a work arrangement in which employees do not commute to a central place of work, such as an office building, warehouse, or store.

words.tr: phrase. 远程工作；不在办公室而在其他地点（如家中）办公
words.ex: Many employees now prefer to work remotely due to the flexibility it offers.
words.ex_cn: 由于远程工作提供的灵活性，许多员工现在更喜欢远程工作。
words.en: To perform one's job from a location other than the traditional office environment, often from home or any place outside the office, using technology to communicate and complete tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 远程工作者；居家办公人员
words.ex: He is a remote worker who works from home.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名在家工作的远程工作者。
words.en: An employee who performs their job from a location other than the office.

words.tr: phrase. 就业前景；工作机会的展望
words.ex: He wants to know his employment prospects after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他想知道毕业后的工作前景。
words.en: The likelihood or possibility of getting a job or employment opportunities in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 职业前景；事业发展机会
words.ex: He wants to know his career prospects after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他想知道毕业后的职业前景。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of future success in a profession or job.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动力市场
words.ex: Many people are looking for jobs in the labour market.
words.ex_cn: 许多人正在劳动力市场上找工作。
words.en: The labour market refers to the supply of and demand for labour, in which employees provide the supply and employers the demand. It is a major component of any economy and is directly linked to the markets for capital, goods, and services.

words.tr: phrase. 行为准则；行为规范
words.ex: The school has a code of conduct for all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为所有学生制定了行为准则。
words.en: A set of rules or principles governing behavior and ethical standards within an organization or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 着装规范
words.ex: The school has a strict dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学校有严格的着装规定。
words.en: A set of rules specifying the attire that is appropriate for a particular place or event.

words.tr: phrase. 职业道德
words.ex: Doctors must follow professional ethics.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须遵守职业道德。
words.en: The moral principles and standards of conduct that guide behavior in a profession.

words.tr: phrase. 新鲜血液；新成员；新力量（常用于比喻引进新人或新资源）
words.ex: The company needs fresh blood to bring new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 公司需要新人来带来新想法。
words.en: New, inexperienced people who join an organization or group, bringing fresh ideas and energy.

words.tr: phrase. 新进入者；新加入者；新成员；新参赛者
words.ex: The new entrant joined the company last week.
words.ex_cn: 这位新加入者上周加入了公司。
words.en: A person or company newly entering a market or field.

words.tr: n. 新来的人；新手；
words.ex: The newcomer joined our class last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个新来的人上周加入了我们的班级。
words.en: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.tr: n. 求职者
words.ex: Many job-seekers are waiting for interviews.
words.ex_cn: 许多求职者正在等待面试。

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找工作；求职
words.ex: He wants to seek employment after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他想在毕业后找工作。
words.en: To seek employment means to look for a job or to try to get hired by an employer.

words.tr: v. 使得；做；制作；
words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr: phrase. 生计，主要收入来源；基本生活所需
words.ex: Teaching is his bread and butter.
words.ex_cn: 教学是他的谋生之道。
words.en: The term 'bread and butter' refers to a person's livelihood or main source of income, often implying that it is essential for their survival.

words.tr: v. 依靠某物维持生活；以某物为生
words.ex: Many villagers subsist on rice and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 许多村民依靠大米和蔬菜维持生活。

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make both ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持收支平衡。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 刮掉；勉强挣得；删去
words.ex: He had to scratch out a living on the farm.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在农场上勉强谋生。
words.en: To remove or delete something by drawing a line through it.

words.tr: v. 以做某事为生
words.ex: He paints pictures for a living.
words.ex_cn: 他以画画为生。

words.w: join the ranks of the unemployed
words.tr: phrase. 加入失业者行列；成为失业人员之一
words.uk: dʒɔɪn ðə ræŋks əv ðə ʌnˈem.ploi.d
words.us: dʒɔɪn ðə ræŋks əv ðə ʌnˈem.ploy.d
words.ex: He had to join the ranks of the unemployed after the factory closed.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他不得不加入失业者的行列。
words.en: To become unemployed, often implying a loss of status or security.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex: After the factory closed, he was out of work for several months.
words.ex_cn: 工厂关闭后，他失业了好几个月。
words.en: To be without a job; unemployed.

words.tr: phrase. 工作保障
words.ex: He wants job security because he has a family to support.
words.ex_cn: 他想要工作保障，因为他要养家。
words.en: Job security refers to the probability that an individual will keep their job; a job with a high level of job security is one with a low risk of unemployment.

words.tr: phrase. 失业的；没有工作的
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为丢了工作。
words.en: To be without a job despite being willing and able to work.

words.tr: phrase. 工作满意度
words.ex: He has high job satisfaction because he likes his work.
words.ex_cn: 他工作满意度很高，因为他喜欢自己的工作。
words.en: Job satisfaction refers to the level of contentment employees feel with their job, which can be influenced by various factors such as work environment, salary, and opportunities for advancement.

words.tr: v. 有权利获得某物；有资格享有某物
phrase. 一种满足感；成就感；圆满感
words.ex: Helping others gives me a sense of fulfillment.
words.ex_cn: 帮助他人给我一种满足感。
words.en: A feeling of happiness or satisfaction because you have achieved something or because something good has happened.

words.tr: n. 沮丧；受挫；挫败；
words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 人才外流；指受过高等教育或具有专业技能的人才大量移居国外的现象
words.ex: The country is experiencing a severe brain drain as many skilled professionals emigrate.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正经历着严重的智囊流失，因为许多专业人士正在移民。
words.en: The emigration of highly trained or intelligent people from a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 工作经验；职业经历
words.ex: He has work experience in a restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在餐厅有工作经验。
words.en: Work experience refers to the knowledge and skills that someone has gained through working in a particular job or field.

words.tr: phrase. 过重的工作负担；过度的工作量
words.ex: He feels tired because of excessive workload.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作量过大而感到疲惫。
words.en: An unreasonably large amount of work assigned to a person or group, often leading to stress and reduced productivity.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动密集型的；需要大量人力的
words.ex: This type of manufacturing is labour intensive.
words.ex_cn: 这种类型的制造业是劳动密集型的。
words.en: Requiring a large amount of work relative to output, often involving human effort rather than machines.

words.tr: phrase. 一个令人感到压抑的截止日期
words.ex: He feels stressed because of an oppressive deadline at work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作中一个压抑的截止日期感到压力很大。
words.en: An oppressive deadline refers to a deadline that is extremely stressful and difficult to meet, often causing anxiety or pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 在巨大压力下工作
words.ex: He can work under enormous stress and still do a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他能在巨大压力下工作，并且仍然做得很好。
words.en: To perform tasks or duties while experiencing a significant amount of pressure or stress.

words.tr: phrase. 对员工友好的环境；一种支持员工福祉、促进工作满意度和积极工作氛围的组织环境
words.ex: The company provides an employee-friendly environment with flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供灵活的工作时间，营造了对员工友好的环境。
words.en: A workplace that is designed to be supportive and beneficial for employees, often including policies or features that promote well-being, satisfaction, and productivity.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.w: work long hours for low pay
words.tr: phrase. 为低薪长时间工作
words.uk: wɜːk lɒŋ ˈaʊəz fɔː ləʊ peɪ
words.us: wɜːrk lɔːŋ ˈaʊərz fɔː loʊ peɪ
words.ex: He works long hours for low pay at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂里长时间工作却赚得很少。
words.en: To work for extended periods of time while receiving minimal compensation.

words.tr: phrase. 休闲娱乐活动
words.ex: He enjoys leisure activities on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末喜欢从事休闲活动。
words.en: Leisure activities refer to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr: phrase. 一份要求很高的工作；需要大量精力、时间或技能的工作
words.ex: He has a demanding job that requires long hours.
words.ex_cn: 他有一份要求很高的工作，需要长时间工作。
words.en: A demanding job is one that requires a lot of time, energy, or attention because of its difficulty or the high standards expected.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr: phrase. 职业道德；工作伦理（指对工作认真负责、勤奋努力的态度）
words.ex: He has a strong work ethic and always finishes his tasks on time.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的职业道德，总是按时完成任务。
words.en: The principle that hard work is intrinsically virtuous or worthy of reward.

words.tr: phrase. 人员配备充足的；拥有足够员工的
words.ex: The hospital is well-staffed with nurses and doctors.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院有充足的护士和医生。
words.en: Having an adequate number of qualified employees to meet operational needs.

words.tr: phrase. 人手不足的；员工短缺的
words.ex: The restaurant was short-staffed on the weekend, so the service was slower than usual.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅周末人手不足，所以服务比平时慢。
words.en: If a company, organization, etc. is short-staffed, it does not have enough employees to work effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的安排；可调整的布置
words.ex: The company offers a flexible arrangement for working hours.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司提供灵活的工作时间安排。
words.en: A flexible arrangement refers to an adaptable or variable plan or agreement that can be modified according to needs or circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 一种工作制度，指每天从早上9点工作到晚上9点，每周工作6天
words.ex: He checks his work schedule every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都查看自己的工作时间表。
words.en: A work schedule where employees are expected to work from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., six days a week, common in some industries in China.

words.tr: phrase. 日常工作；常规作业
words.ex: He does routine work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做常规工作。
words.en: Regular tasks or duties that are part of one's job or daily life, often considered mundane or repetitive.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: v. 在……与……之间引起摩擦；在……与……之间制造矛盾
words.ex: His comments caused friction between the manager and the team.
words.ex_cn: 他的评论在经理和团队之间引起了摩擦。

words.tr: 短语动词。冲突产生；矛盾出现
words.ex: Conflicts arise when people have different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 当人们有不同意见时，冲突就会产生。
words.en: Disagreements or disputes emerge, typically causing tension or problems.

words.tr: phrase. 由压力引发的疾病
words.ex: He got stress-induced diseases from working too hard.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太辛苦而得了压力引起的疾病。
words.en: Illnesses caused or worsened by prolonged psychological pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 工作节奏；工作速度
words.ex: The pace of work in the city can be overwhelming for newcomers.
words.ex_cn: 城市的工作节奏对新人来说可能是压倒性的。
words.en: The speed at which work is done.

words.tr: phrase. 职业危害；职业性风险
words.ex: Working with chemicals is an occupational hazard.
words.ex_cn: 接触化学物质是一种职业风险。
words.en: A risk inherent to a particular job or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 职业病
words.ex: He got an occupational disease from working in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂工作时得了职业病。
words.en: An occupational disease is a health condition or disorder that is caused by the work environment or the activities involved in a person's job.

words.tr: phrase. 极其繁重的；累断腰的（指非常辛苦、耗费体力的工作）
