words.ex: He does backbreaking tasks every day to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做繁重的工作来养家糊口。
words.en: Extremely physically demanding and exhausting work.

words.tr: phrase. 体力劳动；手工劳动
words.ex: Manual work often requires physical strength and endurance.
words.ex_cn: 手工劳动通常需要体力和耐力。
words.en: Physical work done by hand, often requiring physical strength and endurance.

words.tr: phrase. 脑力劳动；心智工作
words.ex: He does mental work every day at his office.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在办公室做脑力劳动。
words.en: Work that requires cognitive effort, concentration, and intellectual engagement.

words.tr: v. 负责某事；主管某事
v. 有；得到；吃；
words.ex: I have a book.
words.ex_cn: 我有一本书。
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.tr: phrase. adj. 极其热衷于工作或活动的人；非常积极主动的人
words.ex: She always arrives early at the office, eager beaver that she is.
words.ex_cn: 她总是早早地到办公室，她就是这样一个非常勤奋的人。
words.en: To be someone who is very enthusiastic and eager to work hard, often to an excessive degree.

words.tr: 短语. 是能力的指标；表示某人能力的标志
words.ex: Her high score on the test is an indicator of her ability to learn quickly.
words.ex_cn: 她在测试中取得的高分是她学习能力强的指标。
words.en: To serve as a sign or proof of someone's skill or capability.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不自在或不适应，好像不在自己熟悉的环境中
words.ex: He feels out of his element when talking about sports.
words.ex_cn: 当他谈论体育时，他感到不自在。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable, awkward, or out of place in a particular situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 对...敏感；与...协调；能感知...的变化
words.ex: She is attuned to the needs of her students.
words.ex_cn: 她对学生的需要很敏感。
words.en: To be attuned to something means to be aware of and understand it, especially the needs, feelings, or changes of something.

words.tr: phrase. 持续工作；不间断地工作
words.ex: He works continuously to finish his project.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地工作以完成他的项目。
words.en: To work without stopping or taking a break.

words.tr: v. 使某人分心，转移某人的注意力
words.ex: The loud music distracted him from his homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让他无法专心做作业。

words.tr: v. 转移某人的注意力（从...）
words.ex: The loud music diverted his attention from his homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐转移了他做作业的注意力。

words.tr: phrase. 过着忙碌的生活
words.ex: He leads a busy life with work and family.
words.ex_cn: 他过着忙碌的生活，要工作又要照顾家庭。
words.en: To have a schedule or lifestyle that is filled with many activities or responsibilities, leaving little free time.

words.tr: phrase. 忙于工作而脱不开身；被工作占用无法分身
words.ex: I can't make it to the meeting because I'm tied up at work.
words.ex_cn: 我不能参加会议，因为工作缠身。
words.en: To be extremely busy or occupied with work, leaving no free time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份压力大且耗时的工作
words.uk: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsjuːmɪŋ dʒɒb
words.us: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsumɪŋ dʒɑːb
words.ex: He has a stressful and time-consuming job as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士，工作压力大又耗时。
words.en: A job that causes significant mental or emotional pressure and requires a large amount of time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份轻松舒适的工作；待遇好且压力小的工作
words.ex: He landed a cushy job right after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后就找到了一份轻松的工作。
words.en: A cushy job is a job that is easy and does not require much effort, often also providing good pay or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 就业前景；工作前景；职业前途
words.ex: The job prospects for graduates in this field are very promising.
words.ex_cn: 这个领域毕业生的就业前景非常乐观。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of future success in employment.

words.tr: n. 动机；诱因；
words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: n. 动机；动力；
words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 激励某人的追随者；激发某人的粉丝
words.ex: A good leader can inspire someone's followers with simple words.
words.ex_cn: 一个好的领导者可以用简单的话语激励某人的追随者。
words.en: To motivate or encourage someone's followers to take action or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之间建立密切的关系；在……之间培养良好的沟通与信任
words.ex: They build a close rapport between teacher and student.
words.ex_cn: 他们在老师和学生之间建立亲密的关系。
words.en: To establish a strong, friendly, and trusting relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 玻璃天花板（指女性或少数群体在职业晋升中遇到的隐形障碍）
words.ex: She broke the glass ceiling in her company.
words.ex_cn: 她打破了公司里的无形晋升壁垒。
words.en: An unofficial barrier to advancement in a profession, especially affecting women and members of minorities.

words.tr: v. 歧视某人；对某人不公平对待
words.ex: The company should not discriminate against someone because of their race.
words.ex_cn: 公司不应该因为某人的种族而歧视他们。

words.tr: phrase. 磨练一项技能；通过练习使技能更加熟练
words.ex: He hones his writing skill every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天磨练自己的写作技巧。
words.en: Refine or perfect a skill through practice and attention to detail.

words.tr: v. 温习；复习（某事）；重新学习（已遗忘的知识或技能）
words.ex: I will brush up on my math before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我会在考试前温习一下数学。

words.tr: phrase. 更新一项技能
words.ex: He updates a skill every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月更新一项技能。
words.en: Improve or modernize an existing skill to keep it current.

words.tr: v. 获得；学会；
words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.tr: v. 栽培；耕作；培养；
words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.tr: n. 某事物的先决条件；必需的前提
words.ex: High school math is a prerequisite for taking calculus.
words.ex_cn: 高中数学是学习微积分的先决条件。

words.tr: n. 某物所必需的条件；必要要素
words.ex: Water is a requisite for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的条件。

words.tr: phrase. 一种必需的事物；必不可少的东西
words.ex: A reliable car is a necessity for people who live in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 对于居住在乡村地区的人来说，一辆可靠的汽车是必需品。
words.en: Something that is essential or required.

words.tr: n. 在某方面的专业知识或专长
words.ex: His expertise in computer programming helped the team win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机编程方面的专业知识帮助团队赢得了比赛。

words.tr: phrase. 某人的专业领域；某人的专长范围
words.ex: His field of expertise is computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他的专业领域是计算机科学。
words.en: The specific area in which a person has expert knowledge or skill.

words.tr: v. 专攻；专门从事某事物
words.ex: He specializes in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。

words.tr: phrase. 可转移技能；指在不同工作或行业中通用的能力，如沟通、团队合作、问题解决等
words.ex: She has transferable skills that help her in any job.
words.ex_cn: 她拥有适用于任何工作的可转移技能。
words.en: Skills that can be applied in different jobs or situations, often acquired through previous experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 硬技能
words.ex: He has strong hard skills in programming and math.
words.ex_cn: 他在编程和数学方面有很强的硬技能。
words.en: Hard skills are specific, teachable abilities or skill sets that are easy to quantify, such as typing, writing, math, reading, and the ability to use software programs.

words.tr: n. 对做某事的天赋；擅长做某事的能力
words.ex: He has an aptitude for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有解决数学问题的天赋。

words.tr: n. 擅长做某事的才能；在某方面有天赋

words.tr: n. 对某事物的短暂涉猎；对某领域的短暂探索

words.en: An area of activity or knowledge that is unfamiliar or unexplored.

words.tr: phrase. 政治文盲的；对政治一无所知（或漠不关心）的

words.w: economically or politically or scientifically or financially literate

words.tr: n. 对某事的无知；对某事物的不了解

words.ex_cn: 该公司在信息技术岗位上面临技能短缺。

words.w: a mismatch between A and B

words.ex: There is a mismatch between the key and the lock.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙和锁不匹配。

words.w: have a firm or good grasp of something

words.w: beyond the grasp or comprehension of someone

words.w: a deep or thorough understanding of something

words.ex_cn: 他对古代历史有深刻的理解。

words.tr: n. 对某事的深入了解；详尽的了解

words.ex_cn: 他对古代历史有深入的了解。

words.tr: n. 在某方面的熟练；精通某事物

words.w: be proficient in or at something

words.w: business or commercial or financial acumen

words.tr: v. 熟悉某事；了解某事

words.tr: 在某人能力范围之内或之外

words.ex_cn: 他利用自己的旧经验来解决这个问题。

words.tr: phrase. 利用；接入；汲取（资源、能量、信息等）

words.tr: phrase. 具有，拥有（某种品质、能力或特征）

words.ex_cn: 他拥有巨大的勇气。
words.en: To have or own something, especially a quality or attribute.

words.tr: phrase. 获得知识；学习知识
words.ex: He wants to acquire knowledge by reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过读书来获取知识。
words.en: To gain information, understanding, or skill through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr: phrase. 天赋；与生俱来的才能

words.ex_cn: 他天生就有弹钢琴的才华。
words.en: Inborn or inherent ability, not learned or developed.

words.tr: 短语动词. 咨询专家；向专家请教

words.ex_cn: 他将向专家咨询他的问题。
words.en: Seek advice or information from someone with specialized knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 解决问题的能力；解题能力

words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上表现出很强的解决问题的能力。
words.en: The capacity to find solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.w: Have the knack of doing something
words.tr: v. 擅长做某事；有做某事的天赋

words.ex_cn: 他擅长快速解决数学问题。

words.tr: adj. 平庸的；
words.ex: The movie was mediocre and not worth watching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很平庸，不值得看。
words.en: If you describe something as mediocre, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.

words.tr: phrase. 对某事了如指掌；对某事彻底熟悉

words.ex_cn: 他对这个计算机程序了如指掌，因为他每天都在用。
words.en: To know something inside out means to be extremely familiar with it, understanding every detail or aspect of it.

words.ex_cn: 我花了一周时间才掌握骑自行车的技巧。

words.tr: phrase. 生疏的；荒废的（指长时间未使用某项技能或知识而变得不熟练）

words.ex_cn: 我的自行车在车库里放了好几年，现在生锈了。
words.en: To be rusty means to be covered with rust or to be out of practice in a particular skill.

words.tr:

words.ex_cn: 他用石头磨刀。
words.en: To hone something means to improve and perfect it over time, especially a skill or technique.

words.ex_cn: 别把你弟弟当作你新饮食法的实验品。

words.tr: phrase. 试验场；测试场地；用于实验或评估某事物的地方

words.en: A place or situation used for testing new ideas or methods.

words.tr: v. 努力争取某物；竭力追求某事

words.ex_cn: 他努力争取更好的生活。

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；力争达成某事

words.ex_cn: 他每天都努力做到最好。
words.en: To make a great effort to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr: v. 努力做某事；尽力去做某事
words.ex: He endeavours to do his best every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都努力做到最好。

words.w: make an effort to do something
words.tr: phrase. 努力去做某事；尽力去做某事
words.uk: meɪk ən ˈefət tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ən ˈefərt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在努力早起。
words.en: To try hard to do something, especially when it is difficult.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 赚得；获得；
words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.tr: adj. 来之不易的；难得的
words.ex: He got a hard-won victory after years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的练习，他获得了来之不易的胜利。
words.en: A hard-won success, victory, or achievement is one that you have worked very hard to get and have achieved with difficulty.

words.tr: v. 声名鹊起；脱颖而出；变得著名或重要

words.ex_cn: 这位年轻歌手的视频走红后声名鹊起。

words.tr: phrase. 发大财；赚大钱；积累巨额财富
words.ex: He made a fortune by selling his small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖掉自己的小生意发了一笔财。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money, often in a short period of time.

words.ex: The temperature rose from 10°C to 25°C in one day.
words.ex_cn: 温度在一天内从10摄氏度上升到25摄氏度。

words.tr: phrase. 从一贫如洗到富贵显赫；白手起家获得巨大成功
words.ex: He went from rags to riches by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业从贫穷变成了富翁。
words.en: To go from being very poor to being very wealthy.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功

words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。

words.w: It pays someone to do something

words.en: The key or hidden principle behind becoming successful.

words.tr: phrase. v. 取得成功；进步；超越他人

words.w: climb up the ladder of success

words.tr: phrase. 一场艰苦的努力；一项困难重重的任务；费力的斗争

words.en: An uphill struggle refers to a difficult task that requires a lot of effort and determination to achieve, similar to climbing a steep hill.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；

words.w: something is a struggle for someone

words.ex_cn: 对他来说，学习阅读是一种挣扎。

words.tr: phrase. 非凡的成就；惊人的壮举

words.ex_cn: 他独自攀登这座山，完成了一项非凡的壮举。
words.en: An extraordinary achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 并非易事；绝非小事；不是什么小成就

words.ex_cn: 攀登珠穆朗玛峰不是一件容易的事。

words.tr: 实现巨大的成功

words.w: have or hold the distinction of

words.ex_cn: 他具有成为最年轻获奖者的荣誉。

words.tr: v. 全身心投入某事；专心致志地做某事

words.w: bend your mind or efforts to doing something

words.w: a ruthless determination to do something

words.tr: adj. 在某事上毫不松懈的；坚持不懈的；不屈不挠的

words.tr: v. 直面某事；勇敢地面对问题

words.ex: The hustle and bustle of the city wakes me up every morning.
words.ex_cn: 城市的喧嚣每天早上都把我吵醒。
words.en: The term 'hustle and bustle' refers to the busy and noisy activity of a lot of people in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 熙熙攘攘的； v. “bustle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The market is bustling with people.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，熙熙攘攘。
words.en: If a place is bustling, it is full of busy activity.

words.tr: v. 充满喧闹繁忙的气氛；熙熙攘攘地充满
phrase. 生活节奏；生活的速度与步调
words.ex: The pace of life in the city is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 城市里的生活节奏非常快。
words.en: The speed at which daily activities and events occur in a person's life.

words.tr: adj. 快节奏的
words.ex: He lives in a fast-paced city.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个节奏很快的城市。
words.en: A fast-paced situation or event happens very quickly because things are being done in a hurry.

words.tr: adj. 紧张忙碌的；
words.ex: Her mornings are hectic with work and kids.
words.ex_cn: 她的早晨因为工作和孩子而紧张忙碌。
words.en: If you describe a situation as hectic, you mean that it is very busy and involves a lot of rushed activity.

words.tr: phrase. 城市无规划扩张
words.ex: The city is growing fast because of urban sprawl.
words.ex_cn: 由于城市无序扩张，这个城市正在快速扩张。
words.en: Urban sprawl refers to the expansion of human populations away from central urban areas into low-density, monofunctional and usually car-dependent communities.

words.tr: phrase. 城市更新；都市重建（指对城市衰败区域进行改造与再开发）
words.ex: The city implemented an urban renewal project to revitalize the downtown area.
words.ex_cn: 该城市实施了一项城市更新计划，以振兴市中心区域。
words.en: Urban renewal refers to the redevelopment of areas within a city, often to improve the infrastructure and living conditions.

words.tr: n. 摩天大楼
words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.tr: adj. 高耸的；杰出的；激烈的； v. “tower”的现在分词；
words.ex: The towering building stood above all others in the city.
words.ex_cn: 那座高耸的建筑矗立在城市中所有其他建筑之上。
words.en: Very tall or high; outstanding or extreme.

words.tr: phrase. 人口稠密的；居住密集的
words.ex: The city is densely populated.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市人口密集。
words.en: An area described as densely populated has a high number of people living in it relative to its size.

words.tr: adj. 人口众多的；人口密集的
words.ex: China is a populous country.
words.ex_cn: 中国是一个人口众多的国家。
words.en: If a place is populous, it has a large population.

words.tr: phrase. 人口稀少的；稀疏居住的
words.ex: The region is sparsely populated, with vast stretches of uninhabited land.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区人口稀少，有大片无人居住的土地。
words.en: An area that is sparsely populated has a small number of people living in it.

words.tr: phrase. 人口爆炸；人口激增
words.ex: The country faces problems because of population explosion.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家因人口爆炸而面临问题。
words.en: A sudden, large increase in the size of a population.

words.tr: v. 有所提供；有值得分享的东西；有能力为他人带来价值
words.ex: He has something to offer in teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 他在团队合作方面有所提供。

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr: adj. 能被某人接触到的；对某人可接近的；对某人可获得的
phrase. 人才外流；指受过高等教育或具有专业技能的人才大量移居国外的现象
words.ex: The country is experiencing a severe brain drain as many skilled professionals emigrate.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正经历着严重的智囊流失，因为许多专业人士正在移民。
words.en: The emigration of highly trained or intelligent people from a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 人才流失；大量有才能的人离开某个组织或国家
words.ex: Many young engineers are leaving the country in an exodus of talent.
words.ex_cn: 许多年轻工程师正以人才外流的方式离开这个国家。
words.en: A large-scale departure of skilled individuals from a place or organization.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的才华；丰富的才能
words.ex: The school has a wealth of talent in music and art.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在音乐和艺术方面拥有大量人才。
words.en: An abundance or great amount of skilled people.

words.tr: phrase. 被…困扰；受…折磨
words.ex: He is plagued by constant headaches.
words.ex_cn: 他一直被头痛困扰。
words.en: To be persistently troubled or annoyed by something.

words.tr: phrase. 被…困扰；被…包围（常指困难、问题等）
words.ex: He is beset by problems at work.
words.ex_cn: 他被工作中的问题困扰。
words.en: To be persistently troubled or harassed by something.

words.tr: v. 被...所负担；被...所压垮
v. 面对；对抗；
words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.tr: phrase. 激烈的竞争；永无休止的奔忙；内卷式职场生活
words.ex: He left the rat race to live a quiet life.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了竞争激烈的生活，过上了宁静的生活。
words.en: A rat race is an endless, self-defeating, or pointless pursuit. It conjures up the image of the futile efforts of a lab rat trying to escape while running around a maze or in a wheel.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙去做某事；慌乱地努力做某事
words.ex: The students scrambled to finish their homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们匆忙赶在上课前完成作业。
words.en: To rush or struggle to do something.

words.tr: v. 争夺做某事；竞相去做某事
words.ex: Two companies vie to win the contract.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司争夺赢得这份合同。

words.w: join the race to do something
words.tr: v. 加入到争相做某事的行列中
words.ex: Many companies join the race to develop AI technology.
words.ex_cn: 许多公司争相开发人工智能技术。

words.tr: n.压力
words.ex: Too many stresses can make you tired.
words.ex_cn: 太多的压力会让你感到疲惫。
words.en: Stresses can refer to pressures or tensions that affect individuals or materials, or it can denote the emphasis placed on certain words or parts of words in speech.

words.tr: adj. 压力重的；
words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.w: put a strain on someone or something
words.tr: v. 给某人或某物带来压力；使某人或某物不堪重负
words.ex: Too much homework can put a strain on students.
words.ex_cn: 太多作业会给学生带来压力。

words.tr: phrase. 社区感；归属感，指个体在群体中感受到的联系、认同与相互支持的心理状态
words.ex: The neighbors have a sense of community because they help each other.
words.ex_cn: 邻居们因为互相帮助而有了社区归属感。
words.en: A feeling of belonging and mutual commitment among members of a group or community.

words.tr: phrase. 一种孤立感；孤独感；与世隔绝的感觉
words.ex: He felt a sense of isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 搬到新城市后，他感到一种孤独感。
words.en: A feeling of being alone and not connected to other people.

words.tr: phrase. 归属感；一种成为某群体一员的感觉
words.ex: He feels a sense of belonging in his small town.
words.ex_cn: 他在小镇上感到归属感。
words.en: A feeling of being accepted and included in a group or community.

words.tr: phrase. 令人咋舌地昂贵的；贵到让人流泪的
words.ex: The phone is eye-wateringly expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机贵得惊人。
words.en: Extremely expensive, to an almost shocking degree.

words.tr: phrase. + adj. 顽固地高；居高不下（形容价格、水平等难以降低）
words.ex: The prices remain stubbornly high.
words.ex_cn: 价格仍然顽固地居高不下。
words.en: Remaining at a high level despite efforts to reduce it.

words.tr: phrase. 跳起来；发生；迅速发展
words.ex: The ball springs up when it hits the ground.
words.ex_cn: 球碰到地面时跳起来。
words.en: To appear or develop quickly and/or suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；迅速产生
words.ex: The idea sprang into existence when he saw the sky.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到天空时，这个想法突然出现了。
words.en: To suddenly come into being or start to exist.

words.tr: phrase. 发芽；大量出现
words.ex: Seeds sprout up after rain.
words.ex_cn: 种子在雨后发芽。
words.en: If a large number of things sprout up, they suddenly appear or begin to exist.

words.tr: phrase. , n.突然出现：指突然从隐藏的位置迅速出现或活动。; 弹出式：指在打开页面时形成一个立体结构的设备或插图。...
words.ex: A message will pop up when you open the app.
words.ex_cn: 当你打开应用程序时，会弹出一条消息。
words.en: If something such as a message or window pops up on a computer screen, it appears there suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 城市地区
words.ex: Many people live in urban areas.
words.ex_cn: 许多人住在城市地区。
words.en: Urban areas are regions characterized by high population density and vast human features in comparison to areas surrounding them. Urban areas may be cities, towns or conurbations, but the term is not commonly extended to rural settlements such as villages and hamlets.

words.tr: phrase. 农村；乡村
words.ex: Many children live in rural areas far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子住在远离城市的农村地区。
words.en: Rural areas are regions located outside towns and cities, often characterized by a lower population density and a focus on agricultural activities.

words.tr: phrase. 市中心（通常指老旧、拥挤、社会问题集中的区域）；内城区
words.ex: The inner city is facing a crisis of poverty and crime.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心正面临贫困和犯罪的危机。
words.en: The central part of a city, especially a large or old city, where the buildings are often in a poor condition and the people are mostly poor.

words.tr: n. 市郊；郊区；
words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.tr: v. 有权利获得某物；有资格享有某物
phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.tr: n. 对某物的权利；享有某物的资格
words.ex: He has an entitlement to his share of the inheritance.
words.ex_cn: 他有权利获得他应得的遗产份额。

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人有极大吸引力；成为某人无法抗拒的吸引源
words.ex: The new amusement park is a magnet for tourists.
words.ex_cn: v. 新的游乐园对游客具有强烈的吸引力。
words.en: To be something that attracts a particular type of person very strongly.

words.tr: v. 受吸引而趋向某物；倾向于某事物
words.ex: Children gravitate to the colorful toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们被色彩鲜艳的玩具吸引而过去。

words.tr: n. 吸引力；
words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.tr: phrase. 田园诗般的乡村生活；乡村的宁静美好生活
words.ex: He lives in a rural idyll with cows and quiet fields.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村仙境，那里有奶牛和宁静的田野。
words.en: An idealized, peaceful countryside life.

words.tr: n. 田园诗般的环境；宁静优美的景色
words.ex: The little village has an idyllic setting with green hills and a quiet river.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄有着田园诗般的环境，四周是青山和宁静的河流。

words.tr: phrase. 过（某种）生活；过着（特定方式）的生活
words.ex: He leads a simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他在乡下过着简单的生活。
words.en: To live or exist in a particular manner or under specific conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 一种奢侈的生活；豪华的生活方式
words.ex: He lives a life of luxury with expensive cars and big houses.
words.ex_cn: 他过着奢华的生活，拥有昂贵的汽车和大房子。
words.en: A lifestyle characterized by great comfort and wealth.

words.tr: phrase. 交通拥挤时间
words.ex: The traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The rush hour is one of the periods of the day when most people are travelling to or from work.

words.tr: phrase. 高峰时段
words.ex: Traffic is heavy during peak hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The time of day when the greatest number of people are traveling or using a service, especially when this causes problems such as traffic jams or delays.

words.tr: phrase. 交通堵塞；交通拥挤
words.ex: The city has too much traffic congestion during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市在高峰时段有严重的交通拥堵。
words.en: A situation in which there is too much traffic and movement is made very slow or stopped.

words.tr: adj. 严重拥堵的；极度拥挤的
words.ex: The road was heavily congested during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段这条路严重拥堵。

words.tr: adj. 车辆一辆接一辆地紧密排列的，通常指交通拥堵的情况。
words.ex: The traffic was bumper-to-bumper during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通拥堵不堪。
words.en: Describing a situation where vehicles are closely packed together, typically in heavy traffic.

words.tr: v. 被...堵塞；被...填满（通常指管道、通道等被杂物阻塞）
words.en: To become blocked or obstructed with a thick, sticky substance, preventing flow or movement.

words.tr: phrase. 在交通堵塞中煎熬；因堵车而受折磨
words.ex: He languishes in traffic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都被堵在车流中。
words.en: To move very slowly in traffic, often with frustration or a sense of wasting time.

words.tr: phrase. 被困在交通拥堵中；因交通堵塞而无法前行
words.ex: He is stuck in traffic on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他被困在高速公路上的车流中。
words.en: To be delayed in a vehicle due to heavy traffic.

words.tr: phrase. 缓慢前行；匍匐前进；慢慢移动
words.ex: The baby crawls along the floor.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝在地上爬行。
words.en: To move at a very slow pace, typically due to heavy traffic or congestion.

words.tr: v. 缓慢到几乎停滞；变得极其缓慢
words.ex: The traffic slowed to a crawl during the rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通慢得像爬行。
words.en: To move very slowly or stop almost completely, often due to congestion.

words.tr: v. 缓慢地移动直至停止
words.ex: The old car crawled to a stop at the end of the road.
words.ex_cn: 那辆旧车缓缓移动，最终停在了路的尽头。

words.tr: 短语动词。逐渐完全停止；陷入停顿
words.ex: The traffic ground to a halt during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨期间，交通逐渐停止了。
words.en: If a process or activity grinds to a halt, it gradually becomes slower or less active until it stops completely.

words.tr: phrase. 挤满；塞满
words.ex: The box is packed with books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子装满了书。
words.en: To be filled or crowded with people or things.

words.tr: phrase. 充满…的；挤满…的（通常指大量活动的人或动物）
words.ex: The garden is swarming with bees.
words.ex_cn: 花园里到处都是蜜蜂。
words.en: To be filled with a large number of people or things, often in a busy or active way.

words.tr: n. 沼泽；湿地；
words.ex: The swamp is full of tall grass and frogs.
words.ex_cn: 这个沼泽里长满了高草和青蛙。
words.en: A swamp is an area of low-lying, uncultivated ground where water collects; a bog or marsh.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地；一来一往
words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.tr: phrase. 来回地
words.ex: The pendulum moves to and fro.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摆动。
words.en: Moving repeatedly from one place to another and back again.

words.tr: phrase. 在移动中；在行进；在忙碌活动；不断前进
words.ex: The children are on the move, playing outside.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在移动中，在外面玩耍。
words.en: If you are on the move, you are going from one place to another, often in a hurry or because you are busy.

words.tr: n. 一段n小时的步行
words.ex: We went on a three-hour walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我们在公园里进行了三小时的步行。

words.tr: phrase. 一段颠簸的旅程；艰难的经历；不顺利的过程
words.ex: The car gave us a rough ride on the dirt road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在土路上颠簸得厉害。
words.en: A difficult, challenging, or unpleasant experience.

words.tr: phrase. 一次轻松的经历；容易完成的任务；顺心的过程
words.ex: The test was an easy ride for her.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对她来说很简单。
words.en: A journey or task that is simple and requires little effort or difficulty.

words.w: impose or set a limit on
words.tr: v. 施加限制；设定上限
words.ex: The government imposed a limit on car usage to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府对汽车使用施加了限制以减少污染。

words.w: impose or set a ceiling on something
words.tr: v. 对某事物施加限制或设定上限
words.ex: The government imposed a ceiling on rent prices.
words.ex_cn: 政府对租金设定了上限。

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.tr: phrase. 废气排放；尾气排放，指发动机燃烧后排出的有害气体
words.ex: Cars produce exhaust emissions that pollute the air.
words.ex_cn: 汽车产生污染空气的尾气排放。
words.en: Exhaust emissions refer to the gases and particles that are released into the air as a result of combustion processes, particularly from vehicles and industrial activities.

words.tr: phrase. 汽油动力车辆；以汽油为燃料的汽车
words.ex: Many petrol-powered vehicles pollute the air.
words.ex_cn: 许多燃油汽车污染空气。
words.en: Vehicles that are powered by gasoline (petrol) rather than electricity or other fuels.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 马具；
words.ex: We must harness the power of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须利用太阳的能量。
words.en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；欺骗；占便宜
words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: n. 酒后驾驶
words.ex: He was arrested for drink-driving last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚因酒后驾驶被逮捕。

words.tr: phrase. 鲁莽驾驶；危险驾驶
words.ex: He was fined for reckless driving.
words.ex_cn: 他因危险驾驶被罚款。
words.en: Driving in a way that shows a disregard for the safety of others.

words.tr: phrase. 路怒症；驾车时的愤怒攻击行为
words.ex: He shouted at another driver because of road rage.
words.ex_cn: 他因为路怒症对另一名司机大喊大叫。
words.en: Road rage refers to aggressive or angry behavior exhibited by a driver of a road vehicle, which can include rude gestures, verbal insults, deliberately driving in an unsafe or threatening manner, or making threats.

words.tr: phrase. 运输基础设施；指支持交通运输系统的设施，如道路、铁路、机场、港口等
words.ex: The city built new transport infrastructure to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市建造了新的交通基础设施以减少交通拥堵。
words.en: The physical networks and facilities used for moving people and goods, including roads, railways, ports, and airports.

words.tr: phrase. 道路网络；公路网
words.ex: The city improved its road network last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改善了它的道路网络。
words.en: A road network is a system of connected roads and highways that allows for travel and transport within a region.

words.tr: phrase. 交通瓶颈；指道路上因容量不足或障碍导致车流受阻的路段
words.ex: The traffic bottleneck causes long delays at rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 交通瓶颈在高峰时段导致长时间延误。
words.en: A traffic bottleneck is a section of a road or highway where the flow of traffic is significantly reduced, often causing delays and congestion.

words.tr: adj. 塞紧的，拥挤不堪的 v. 塞紧，塞得透不过气( jam-pack的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The bus was jam-packed with students.
words.ex_cn: 公交车里挤满了学生。
words.en: Extremely crowded or full.

words.tr: n. 通勤者；经常往返者；
words.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。
words.en: A commuter is someone who travels a long distance to work every day.

words.tr: n. 汽油
words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.tr: n. 油；石油；
words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.tr: phrase. 混合动力车
words.ex: He drives a hybrid car to save fuel.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆混合动力汽车以节省燃油。
words.en: A hybrid car is a vehicle that uses two or more distinct power sources to move, typically combining an internal combustion engine with an electric motor.

words.tr: phrase. 耗油量
words.ex: The car has high fuel consumption.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车油耗很高。
words.en: The amount of fuel used by a vehicle or machine over a certain period or distance.

words.tr: phrase. 缓慢地一点点向前移动；缓慢推进
words.ex: The car inches along in heavy traffic.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在拥堵的交通中缓慢前行。
words.en: To move forward very slowly and with difficulty, like an inch at a time.

words.tr: phrase. 越界的；禁止入内的
words.ex: The ball went out of bounds during the game.
words.ex_cn: 球在比赛中出了界。
words.en: If something is out of bounds, people are not allowed to do it, go to it, or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 车流量；交通量
words.ex: The volume of traffic on the roads has increased significantly during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰时段，道路上的车流量显著增加。
words.en: The amount of vehicles moving along a road or in an area.

words.tr: phrase. 交通密度；单位时间内道路上车辆的密集程度
words.ex: The traffic density is high during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通密度很高。
words.en: The degree of congestion of vehicles or pedestrians in a particular area, often measured as the number of vehicles or people per unit area of road space.

words.tr: phrase. 耗油量大的汽车或机器；油老虎
words.ex: He drives a gas guzzler that uses too much fuel.
words.ex_cn: 他开的是一辆耗油很大的车。
words.en: A vehicle that consumes an excessive amount of fuel, typically a large or powerful model.

words.tr: phrase. 酒后驾驶；醉酒驾驶
words.ex: Drunk driving is a serious offense that endangers lives.
words.ex_cn: 酒后驾驶是一种危及生命的严重违法行为。
words.en: The act of driving a vehicle while impaired by alcohol to the extent that one's mental faculties are significantly reduced.

words.tr: phrase. 损害某人的驾驶能力
words.ex: Drinking alcohol can impair a person's driving ability.
words.ex_cn: 喝酒会损害人的驾驶能力。
words.en: Reduce a person's capacity to operate a vehicle safely.

words.tr: 短语动词. 平安无事地到达某地；安全地抵达某个地方
words.ex: They walked for hours but finally got somewhere safe and sound.
words.ex_cn: 他们走了几个小时，终于安全到达了一个安全的地方。
words.en: To arrive at a place without any harm or damage.

words.tr: phrase. 曲折；迂回；波折（常指情节、道路或人生的复杂变化）
words.ex: The story has many twists and turns.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事有很多曲折。
words.en: Complex, unpredictable developments or changes in a situation or story.

words.tr: phrase. 混乱的局面；混战；无规则的争斗
words.ex: The debate turned into a free-for-all.
words.ex_cn: 辩论变成了一场混战。
words.en: A situation in which everyone can do what they want without any rules or control.

words.tr: adj. 组织良好的
words.ex: He is a well-organized student.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有条理的学生。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient and effective way.

words.tr: phrase. 在交叉路口；在交汇处
words.ex: The two roads meet at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在交叉口相会。
words.en: Located where two or more roads meet or cross.

words.tr: phrase. 猛踩刹车；急刹车
words.ex: He jammed on the brakes to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 他猛踩刹车以避开那只狗。
words.en: To press the brakes of a vehicle suddenly and forcefully in order to stop quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 超过速度限制，超速驾驶
words.ex: He went over the speed limit and got a ticket.
words.ex_cn: 他超速了，收到了罚单。
words.en: To drive faster than the legally permitted speed.

words.tr: phrase. 碳足迹；指个人、组织、活动或产品直接和间接产生的温室气体排放总量
words.ex: He tries to reduce his carbon footprint by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来减少自己的碳足迹。
words.en: The amount of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds emitted due to the consumption of fossil fuels by a particular person, group, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 碳排放
words.ex: Factories cause carbon emission into the air.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向空气中排放二氧化碳。
words.en: The release of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, primarily from burning fossil fuels.

words.tr: phrase. 环境足迹
words.ex: We can reduce our environmental footprint by using less plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以通过减少使用塑料来减少我们的环境足迹。
words.en: The environmental footprint refers to the impact of human activities on the environment, measured in terms of biologically productive land and water area required to produce the goods consumed and to assimilate the wastes generated.

words.tr: phrase. 减少碳排放
words.ex: Governments worldwide are implementing policies to cut carbon emissions.
words.ex_cn: 世界各国政府正在实施政策以减少碳排放。
words.en: To reduce the amount of carbon dioxide and other carbon compounds released into the atmosphere, especially as a result of human activity.

words.tr: n. 排放减少；温室气体排放的削减
words.ex: The factory made emissions reduction a top priority.
words.ex_cn: 该工厂将排放减少列为首要任务。

words.tr: phrase. 碳中和的；实现净零碳排放的
words.ex: Our company aims to become carbon neutral by 2030.
words.ex_cn: 我们公司计划到2030年实现碳中和。
words.en: Achieving carbon neutrality means balancing emitted carbon with an equivalent amount sequestered or offset.

words.tr: phrase. 严重依赖于...
words.ex: Students rely heavily on teachers for help.
words.ex_cn: 学生非常依赖老师来获得帮助。
words.en: To depend on someone or something to a great extent for support or help.

words.tr: adj. 高度依赖的；严重依赖的
adj. 遭受干旱的
words.ex: The drought-stricken farmers lost their crops.
words.ex_cn: 遭受干旱的农民失去了他们的庄稼。
words.en: Affected severely by a prolonged period of little or no rain.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.tr: v. 遭受严重打击；受到重创
n. 对某事物有贡献的人
words.ex: He is a contributor to the local food bank.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地食品银行的贡献者。

words.tr: phrase. 驱动力；推动力
words.ex: Passion is the driving force behind her success.
words.ex_cn: 热情是她成功的驱动力。
words.en: A driving force is a person or thing that has a very powerful effect on what happens or on how people behave.

words.tr: phrase. 对...负责
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.tr: n. 得罪人的人；犯罪者；违法者；
words.ex: He was punished because he was an offender who hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为是一个得罪朋友的人而受到惩罚。
words.en: An offender is a person who commits a crime or does something wrong.

words.tr: adj. 一次性的；
words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.tr: adj. 可再用的
words.ex: She uses a reusable bottle for water.
words.ex_cn: 她用一个可重复使用的瓶子装水。
words.en: Able to be used again or more than once.

words.tr: adj. 不可生物降解的；无法被自然分解的
words.ex: Plastic bags are non-biodegradable and harm the environment.
words.ex_cn: 塑料袋是非生物降解的，会对环境造成危害。
words.en: Not capable of being broken down naturally by microorganisms.

words.w: wean someone off or from something
words.tr: v. 使某人戒除（某种习惯、药物等）；逐渐让某人脱离对某物的依赖
words.ex: The doctor helped him wean off painkillers.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助他戒除了止痛药。

words.tr: phrase. 使逐步淘汰；逐渐停止
words.ex: The company will phase out old machines next year.
words.ex_cn: 公司明年将逐步淘汰旧机器。
words.en: To gradually stop using or providing something, especially over a period of time.

words.tr: v. 摆脱某物；丢掉某物；消除某物
words.ex: I want to get rid of this old chair.
words.ex_cn: 我想摆脱这把旧椅子。

words.tr: phrase. 被赋予；有幸拥有（某种天赋、品质或好处）
words.ex: She is blessed with a talent for music.
words.ex_cn: v. 她有幸拥有音乐天赋。
words.en: To be fortunate enough to have something, especially a quality or ability.

words.tr: phrase. 被赋予，天生具有（某种品质或能力）
words.ex: He is endowed with great talent.
words.ex_cn: 他天生具有非凡的才华。
words.en: If someone or something is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they have it by nature.

words.tr: phrase. 含有丰富的…；富于
words.ex: This soil is rich in nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含养分。
words.en: To contain a large amount of something beneficial or valuable.

words.tr: v. 大量存在；充满；丰富地拥有某物
words.ex: The forest abounds with birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林里有大量的鸟。

words.w: keep or hold something in check
words.tr: v. 控制；抑制；约束某物
words.ex: The teacher keeps the class in check.
words.ex_cn: 老师控制着课堂秩序。

words.tr: v. 使某物保持距离；防止某物接近或侵入
words.ex: The fence helps keep wild animals at bay.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏有助于使野生动物保持距离。

words.tr: v. 勒住；抑制；
words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.tr: 短语动词，是…的所在地；为…提供栖息地或场所
words.ex: This forest be home to many wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是许多野生动物的家园。
words.en: If a place is home to a person or thing, it is the place where they live, are based, or are found.

words.tr: phrase. 被...居住；被...栖息
words.ex: The old house is inhabited by bats.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子由蝙蝠居住。
words.en: to be lived in or occupied by people or animals.

words.tr: phrase. 天然栖息地
words.ex: The panda lives in its natural habitat.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫生活在它的自然栖息地中。
words.en: The natural environment in which an organism or a community normally lives or occurs.

words.w: be on the verge or edge of extinction
words.tr: v. 濒临灭绝
v. 濒临灭绝
phrase.  灭绝；逐渐消失
words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻环境损害；缓解对环境造成的破坏
words.ex: We plant trees to mitigate environmental damage.
words.ex_cn: 我们植树以减轻环境破坏。
words.en: to reduce the severity or impact of harm caused to the natural world.

words.tr: v. 缓解某事物的影响
words.ex: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 种树可以缓解空气污染的影响。

words.tr: v. 抵消某物的影响
words.ex: Drinking water can counter the effects of too much salt.
words.ex_cn: 喝水可以抵消过多盐分的影响。

words.tr: phrase. 区分对与错；辨别是非
words.ex: Children must learn to distinguish right from wrong.
words.ex_cn: 孩子必须学会分辨对错。
words.en: To tell the difference between what is morally right and wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 分辨是非；辨别对错
words.ex: Children must learn to tell right from wrong.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们必须学会分辨对错。
words.en: Distinguish between what is morally right and what is wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 区分 A 和 B；辨别两者之间的差异
words.ex: He can differentiate between a cat and a dog.
words.ex_cn: 他能区分猫和狗。
words.en: To recognize or explain the differences between two distinct things or concepts.

words.tr: phrase. 人生观；对生活的看法
words.ex: Her positive outlook on life helped her overcome many challenges.
words.ex_cn: 她积极的人生观帮助她克服了许多挑战。
words.en: The way someone thinks about and perceives life and their existence.

words.tr: phrase. 社会价值观；指社会成员普遍认同和遵循的道德、行为或文化准则
words.ex: Education plays a crucial role in shaping social values.
words.ex_cn: 教育在塑造社会价值观中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: Social values are the beliefs and principles that a society considers important and desirable, influencing the behavior and attitudes of its members.

words.tr: phrase. 世界观；对世界的看法；对人生的态度
words.ex: His outlook on the world is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对世界的看法是积极的。
words.en: A person's perspective, attitude, or overall view regarding life, society, or global affairs.

words.w: leave someone to their own devices
words.tr: phrase. 让某人自行其是；放任某人自己想办法；听任某人自生自灭
words.uk: liːv ˈsʌmwʌn tu ðeə əʊn dɪˈvaɪsɪz
words.us: liːv ˈsʌmwʌn tu ðer oʊn dɪˈvaɪsɪz
words.ex: The teacher left the students to their own devices during the free period.
words.ex_cn: 老师在自由活动时间让学生们自己安排。
words.en: To allow someone to do what they want without trying to control them or tell them what to do.

words.tr: v. 放某人自由；释放某人
words.ex: The teacher let the students loose after class.
words.ex_cn: 老师下课后放学生们自由活动。

words.tr: v. 留意某人；监视某人；照看某人
words.ex: Please keep an eye on my little brother while I cook.
words.ex_cn: 我做饭时，请留意一下我弟弟。

words.tr: phrase. 注意力的广度（注意力的持续时间）
words.ex: Children have a short attention span.
words.ex_cn: 儿童的注意力持续时间很短。
words.en: The length of time for which a person is able to concentrate on a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: v. 将某人的注意力从……转移开
words.ex: The loud music diverted her attention away from the problem.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐将她的注意力从问题上转移开了。

words.tr: v. 使某人忙于某事；让某人有事做以打发时间
words.ex: The teacher gave the kids puzzles to keep them occupied.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了孩子们拼图，让他们忙起来。

words.tr: phrase. 吸引某人的注意力；使某人专心
words.ex: The colorful pictures engage his attention.
words.ex_cn: 这些彩色的图片吸引了他的注意力。
words.en: To capture and hold someone's interest or focus completely.

words.tr: phrase. 一个榜样；楷模
words.ex: My teacher is a role model for me.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我榜样。
words.en: Someone who is admired and serves as an example for others to follow.

words.w: set an example to or for someone
words.tr: v. 为某人树立榜样
words.ex: Parents should set an example for their children by being honest.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该通过诚实为孩子树立榜样。

words.tr: phrase. 以身作则；作榜样
words.ex: The teacher leads by example and always arrives early.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师以身作则，总是早早到达。
words.en: To show people how to behave or to do something by doing it yourself first.

words.tr: phrase. 跟随某人的脚步；效仿某人；继承某人的事业或行为方式
words.ex: He wants to follow in his father's footsteps and become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想追随父亲的脚步，成为一名医生。
words.en: To do the same thing as someone else, especially someone in your family, did previously.

words.tr: phrase. 跟着做；照着做；效仿（他人行为）
words.ex: When the teacher stood up, the students followed suit.
words.ex_cn: 当老师站起来时，学生们也跟着站了起来。
words.en: To follow suit means to do the same thing as someone else has done.

words.tr: adj. 易受影响的
words.ex: He is impressionable and easily believes what others say.
words.ex_cn: 他容易受影响，很容易相信别人说的话。
words.en: Someone who is impressionable is easily influenced by other people's opinions or actions.

words.tr: phrase. 受支配；从属于；受制；常遭受...
words.ex: He is subject to fines if he breaks the rules.
words.ex_cn: 如果他违反规则，就会被罚款。
words.en: If someone or something is subject to something, especially something bad, it is likely or certain to be affected by it.

words.tr: phrase. 情感上成熟的；能够以理智和稳定的方式处理情绪和人际关系的
words.ex: He is emotionally mature for his age.
words.ex_cn: 他在同龄人中情绪上很成熟。
words.en: Having the ability to manage and understand one's emotions in a healthy and constructive manner.

words.tr: 对某事免疫；不受某事影响
adv. 在年幼时；在很小的年纪
words.ex: He learned to play the piano at a tender age.
words.ex_cn: 他在年幼时就学会了弹钢琴。

words.w: have high expectations of someone or something
words.tr: v. 对某人或某事抱有很高的期望
words.ex: My parents have high expectations of me.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我抱有很高的期望。

words.w: expect something of or from someone
words.tr: v. 期望某人有所作为；对某人抱有期望
words.ex: Parents often expect something of their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母常常期望孩子有所作为。

words.tr: phrase. 不辜负；做到；实践（诺言等）
words.ex: He tried hard to live up to his father's expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他努力不辜负父亲的期望。
words.en: To perform as well as or achieve what is expected or promised.

words.tr: phrase. 未能达到某人的期望
words.ex: He fell short of his parents' expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他未能达到父母的期望。

words.tr: phrase. 同伴压力；同辈压力
words.ex: He gave in to peer pressure and smoked cigarettes.
words.ex_cn: 他屈服于同龄人的压力，抽了香烟。
words.en: Influence from members of one's peer group.

words.tr: phrase. 学术压力；学业压力
words.ex: He feels academic pressure to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感到要取得好成绩的学业压力。
words.en: The stress or burden experienced by students due to the demands and expectations of academic performance.

words.w: be under pressure to do something
words.tr: v. 受到压力要做某事

words.w: lavish attention or love on someone
words.tr: v. 给某人慷慨的关怀或爱意
words.ex: She lavishes attention on her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都给弟弟慷慨的关怀。

words.w: show or have little regard for someone or something
words.tr: v. 对某人或某事表现出很少的尊重或重视
words.ex: He never listens to his teacher and shows little regard for her advice.
words.ex_cn: 他从不听老师的话，对老师的建议毫不重视。

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注；专心致志；未被分散的注意力
words.ex: He gave his child undivided attention during bedtime.
words.ex_cn: 他在孩子睡觉时给予了全神贯注的关注。
words.en: Complete focus and concentration on one person or thing, without any distractions.

words.tr: phrase. 无条件的爱；不附加任何条件的爱
words.ex: Her mother gives her unconditional love.
words.ex_cn: 她的母亲给予她无条件的爱。
words.en: Unconditional love: Love that is given freely and without any conditions, expectations, or limitations.

words.w: give someone a head start over someone
words.tr: v. 给某人比其他人更早的起点或优势
words.ex: Private schools give children a head start over public school students.
words.ex_cn: 私立学校给孩子们比公立学校学生更早的起点。

words.w: get or have a head start
words.tr: v. 率先开始；占领先机；取得优势
words.ex: He got a head start by waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他通过早起率先开始了。

words.tr: phrase. 继承而来的特权；因出身而享有的特权
words.ex: He inherited privilege from his wealthy parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从富裕的父母那里继承了特权。
words.en: Inherited privilege: Advantages, rights, or benefits that are passed down from one generation to the next, often without personal effort.

words.tr: phrase. 来自社会经济地位较低或资源匮乏背景的
words.ex: Many students from disadvantaged backgrounds work hard to go to college.
words.ex_cn: 许多来自不利背景的学生努力学习以进入大学。
words.en: Coming from a situation where individuals lack access to the same opportunities, resources, or social advantages as others.

words.tr: phrase. 来自贫困背景的；来自资源匮乏环境的
words.ex: Many students from deprived backgrounds work hard to succeed.
words.ex_cn: 许多来自贫困背景的学生努力学习以取得成功。
words.en: Coming from areas or families with a lack of money, opportunities, or advantages.

words.tr: phrase. 来自享有特权背景的；来自优越社会经济环境的
words.ex: They come from privileged backgrounds and have many opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 他们来自富裕家庭，拥有许多机会。
words.en: From privileged backgrounds: Having been raised in circumstances of wealth, advantage, or social status that provide significant opportunities.

words.tr: v. 反抗某人或某事物
words.ex: The students rebel against the strict school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们反抗严格的校规。

words.tr: adj. 反叛的；叛逆的
words.ex: The rebellious boy refused to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个叛逆的男孩拒绝遵守规则。
words.en: If you think someone is rebellious, you mean that they are deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 与…背道而驰；与…相抵触；违背
words.ex: His opinion runs counter to the teacher's.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与老师的相反。
words.en: If one thing runs counter to another, it is very different from it and seems to conflict with it.

words.tr: phrase. 情感支持；情绪上的安慰与鼓励
words.ex: Her dog gives her emotional support when she is sad.
words.ex_cn: 当她难过时，她的狗给予她情感支持。
words.en: Emotional support refers to the act of providing comfort, reassurance, and encouragement to someone, especially during times of stress or difficulty.

words.tr: v. 与某人建立牢固的关系
words.ex: They worked together to forge a bond with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起努力与彼此建立牢固的关系。

words.w: feel alienated from someone or something
words.tr: v. 感到与某人或某物疏远、隔绝
words.ex: He feels alienated from his family after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 在争吵之后，他感到与家人疏远了。

words.tr: phrase. 自力更生的；依靠自己的；独立自主的
words.ex: He learned to be self-reliant after moving out of his parents' house.
words.ex_cn: 搬出父母家后，他学会了自力更生。
words.en: To be self-reliant means to rely on one's own powers and resources rather than those of others.

words.tr: adj. 自给自足的；能独立维持自己生活的
words.ex: He wants to be self-sufficient by growing his own food.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过自己种食物来实现自给自足。
words.en: Be able to provide for one's own needs without external assistance.

words.w: be a self-made man or woman
words.tr: v. 成为白手起家的人；靠自己努力成功的人
phrase. 表现出主动性；主动采取行动
words.ex: He shows initiative by helping others without being asked.
words.ex_cn: 他主动帮助别人，表现出积极性。
words.en: Display the ability to assess and initiate tasks independently without being told.

words.w: do something of one's own accord
words.tr: v. 自愿做某事；自发地做某事；不待他人要求而主动去做
words.ex: He apologized of his own accord.
words.ex_cn: 他自愿道了歉。

words.tr: adv. 自愿地；出于自愿；主动地
phrase. 顽强的；坚韧不拔的；固执的
words.ex: He is tenacious and never gives up.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持不懈，从不放弃。
words.en: To be persistent and determined in the face of difficulty.

words.tr: n. 毅力；
words.ex: His perseverance helped him finish the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 他的毅力帮助他完成了马拉松。
words.en: Perseverance is the quality of continuing to try to achieve a particular aim despite difficulties.

words.tr: n. 意志力；毅力；
words.ex: He lost weight by using his willpower.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借意志力减掉了体重。
words.en: Willpower is the ability to control yourself and to make yourself do things that are difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守诺言；守信用
words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.tr: phrase. 正直的公民；品行端正的市民
words.ex: He is an upright citizen who always follows the law.
words.ex_cn: 他是个正直的公民，总是遵守法律。
words.en: A person who is honest, moral, and follows the law.

words.tr: v. 维护某人的正直；保持某人的道德操守
words.ex: He refused to lie to preserve his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝撒谎以维护自己的正直。

words.tr: phrase. 务实的；实事求是的
words.ex: She's very down-to-earth and doesn't care about fancy titles.
words.ex_cn: 她非常务实，不在乎花哨的头衔。
words.en: If you say that someone is down-to-earth, you approve of the fact that they concern themselves with practical things and actions, rather than with abstract theories.

words.tr: phrase. 非常艺术的；过分追求艺术感的；矫揉造作的
words.ex: He is very arty and loves painting every day.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有艺术气质，喜欢每天画画。
words.en: To behave or appear in a way that is very artistic or pretentiously artistic.

words.tr: phrase. 具有艺术性的；有艺术天赋的；富有创造力的
words.ex: She loves to be artistic in her approach to teaching.
words.ex_cn: v. 她在教学方法上喜欢有艺术性。
words.en: To have or show skill in the arts, especially in creating beautiful or expressive things.

words.tr: adj. 世界知名的
words.ex: He is a world-renowned scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位世界闻名的科学家。
words.en: Known and admired throughout the world; famous globally.

words.tr: phrase. 一夜成名的人或事；迅速取得的成功
words.ex: He became an overnight success after his song went viral.
words.ex_cn: 他的歌曲走红后，一夜之间成名了。
words.en: A sudden and rapid achievement of fame or success.

words.tr: 某人的遗产或影响继续存在
words.ex: Even after he died, someone's legacy lives on through his books.
words.ex_cn: 即使他去世了，某人的遗产或影响仍通过他的书籍继续存在。

words.tr: n. 某人拥有大量追随者
words.ex: The singer has a large following on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在社交媒体上拥有大量追随者。

words.tr: v. 为某事设立标准；树立典范
words.ex: This company set the benchmark for customer service.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司为客户服务设立了标准。

words.tr: v. 崇拜某人；敬仰某人
words.ex: He worships his father for being so brave.
words.ex_cn: 他崇拜他的父亲，因为父亲很勇敢。

words.tr: v. 亲自与某人见面
words.ex: I want to meet someone in person to talk face to face.
words.ex_cn: 我想亲自见一个人，当面聊聊。
words.en: Meet someone in person: Encounter or have a direct, face-to-face interaction with another individual.

words.tr: adj. 错误的；不正确的；不当的；
words.ex: The answer is wrong.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是错误的。
words.en: If you say there is something wrong, you mean there is something unsatisfactory about the situation, person, or thing you are talking about.

words.tr: phrase. 多才多艺的；用途广泛的；可适应多种功能的
words.ex: He can play guitar, paint, and code—he is versatile.
words.ex_cn: 他会弹吉他、画画和编程——他多才多艺。
words.en: Able to adapt to many different functions or activities.

words.tr: phrase. 有进取心的人；积极向上、主动进取的人
words.ex: He is a go-getter who always finishes his work early.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是早早完成工作的积极进取的人。
words.en: A go-getter is someone who is very energetic, determined to succeed, and able to deal with new or difficult situations easily.

words.w: a consummate actor or actress or athlete
words.tr: adj. 出色的演员或女演员或运动员；技艺精湛的
words.ex: He is a consummate actor who wins awards every year.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位出色的演员，每年都获奖。

words.tr: n. 奇才；
words.ex: The boy is a piano prodigy at age six.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩六岁时就是一位钢琴奇才。
words.en: A prodigy is someone who is unusually young and has a great natural ability in a particular area.

words.w: people from all walks of life
words.tr: phrase. 各行各业的人；社会各阶层人士
words.uk: ˈpiːpl frəm ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf
words.us: ˈpiːpl frəm ɔːl wɔːks əv laɪf
words.ex: People from all walks of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all walks of life refers to individuals from various professions, backgrounds, or social statuses.

words.w: people who live next door to you
words.tr: phrase. 住在你隔壁的人；你的隔壁邻居
words.uk: ˈpiːpl huː lɪv nekst dɔː tuː juː
words.us: ˈpiːpl huː lɪv nekst doʊr tuː juː
words.ex: The people who live next door to you are nice.
words.ex_cn: 住在你隔壁的人很友好。
words.en: Your neighbours; the people living in the house or flat next to yours.

words.tr: phrase. 从一贫如洗到富贵显赫；白手起家获得巨大成功
words.ex: He went from rags to riches by starting a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过创办一家小企业从贫穷变成了富翁。
words.en: To go from being very poor to being very wealthy.

words.w: is a subject very close to one's heart
words.tr: phrase. 是一个非常贴近某人内心的话题；是某人十分关切的事情
words.uk: /ɪz ə ˈsʌbdʒekt ˈveri kləʊs tu wʌnz hɑːt/
words.us: /ɪz ə ˈsʌbdʒekt ˈvɛri kloʊs tə wʌnz hɑrt/
words.ex: Math is a subject very close to one's heart.
words.ex_cn: 数学是一个让人非常热爱的科目。
words.en: Something that one feels very passionate about or has a deep personal connection to.

words.tr: v. 担心某事；关心某事
phrase. 是一种奢侈；是一件奢侈品；是难得的享受
words.ex: A private car is a luxury for many families.
words.ex_cn: 对于许多家庭来说，私家车是一种奢侈。
words.en: Something expensive and desirable but not essential.

words.tr: phrase. 是绝对必要的；是必不可少的事物
words.ex: Water is an absolute necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命绝对必需的。
words.en: Something absolutely essential; a basic requirement.

words.w: is part and parcel of being famous
words.tr: phrase. 成名的固有部分；成名所不可避免的组成部分
words.uk: pɑːt ənd ˈpɑːsl əv ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfeɪməs
words.us: pɑːrt ənd ˈpɑːrsl əv ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfeɪməs
words.ex: Being watched everywhere is part and parcel of being famous.
words.ex_cn: 随时随地被人关注是成名的一部分。
words.en: Being famous involves certain inevitable aspects or responsibilities.

words.tr: n. 名人；
words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.tr: n. 狗仔队
words.ex: The paparazzi took photos of the celebrity at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 狗仔队在机场拍下了这位名人的照片。
words.en: Paparazzi are photographers who follow famous people around in order to take pictures of them that they can sell to newspapers or magazines.

words.tr: phrase. 奢侈的生活方式；挥霍无度的生活
words.ex: They live extravagant lifestyles with expensive cars and big houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们过着奢侈的生活，拥有昂贵的汽车和大房子。
words.en: Extravagant lifestyles involve spending money or using resources in a lavish, excessive, and often wasteful manner.

words.tr: 短语. 是能力的指标；表示某人能力的标志
words.ex: Her high score on the test is an indicator of her ability to learn quickly.
words.ex_cn: 她在测试中取得的高分是她学习能力强的指标。
words.en: To serve as a sign or proof of someone's skill or capability.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不自在或不适应，好像不在自己熟悉的环境中
words.ex: He feels out of his element when talking about sports.
words.ex_cn: 当他谈论体育时，他感到不自在。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable, awkward, or out of place in a particular situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 对...敏感；与...协调；能感知...的变化
words.ex: She is attuned to the needs of her students.
words.ex_cn: 她对学生的需要很敏感。
words.en: To be attuned to something means to be aware of and understand it, especially the needs, feelings, or changes of something.

words.tr: phrase. 不分昼夜地工作；连续不停地工作
words.ex: The nurses work around the clock to care for patients.
words.ex_cn: 护士们日夜不停地照顾病人。
words.en: Working continuously, day and night, without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 持续工作；不间断地工作
words.ex: He works continuously to finish his project.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地工作以完成他的项目。
words.en: To work without stopping or taking a break.

words.tr: v. 使某人分心，转移某人的注意力
words.ex: The loud music distracted him from his homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让他无法专心做作业。

words.tr: v. 转移某人的注意力（从...）
words.ex: The loud music diverted his attention from his homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐转移了他做作业的注意力。

words.tr: phrase. 过着忙碌的生活
words.ex: He leads a busy life with work and family.
words.ex_cn: 他过着忙碌的生活，要工作又要照顾家庭。
words.en: To have a schedule or lifestyle that is filled with many activities or responsibilities, leaving little free time.

words.tr: phrase. 忙于工作而脱不开身；被工作占用无法分身
words.ex: I can't make it to the meeting because I'm tied up at work.
words.ex_cn: 我不能参加会议，因为工作缠身。
words.en: To be extremely busy or occupied with work, leaving no free time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份压力大且耗时的工作
words.uk: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsjuːmɪŋ dʒɒb
words.us: ə ˈstresful ənd ˈtaɪm kənˌsumɪŋ dʒɑːb
words.ex: He has a stressful and time-consuming job as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士，工作压力大又耗时。
words.en: A job that causes significant mental or emotional pressure and requires a large amount of time.

words.tr: phrase. 一份轻松舒适的工作；待遇好且压力小的工作
words.ex: He landed a cushy job right after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后就找到了一份轻松的工作。
words.en: A cushy job is a job that is easy and does not require much effort, often also providing good pay or conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 就业前景；工作前景；职业前途
words.ex: The job prospects for graduates in this field are very promising.
words.ex_cn: 这个领域毕业生的就业前景非常乐观。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of future success in employment.

words.tr: n. 动机；诱因；
words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr: n. 动机；动力；
words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 激励某人的追随者；激发某人的粉丝
words.ex: A good leader can inspire someone's followers with simple words.
words.ex_cn: 一个好的领导者可以用简单的话语激励某人的追随者。
words.en: To motivate or encourage someone's followers to take action or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之间建立密切的关系；在……之间培养良好的沟通与信任
words.ex: They build a close rapport between teacher and student.
words.ex_cn: 他们在老师和学生之间建立亲密的关系。
words.en: To establish a strong, friendly, and trusting relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 玻璃天花板（指女性或少数群体在职业晋升中遇到的隐形障碍）
words.ex: She broke the glass ceiling in her company.
words.ex_cn: 她打破了公司里的无形晋升壁垒。
words.en: An unofficial barrier to advancement in a profession, especially affecting women and members of minorities.

words.tr: v. 歧视某人；对某人不公平对待
words.ex: The company should not discriminate against someone because of their race.
words.ex_cn: 公司不应该因为某人的种族而歧视他们。

words.tr: phrase. 把某人引入歧途；使某人误入歧途；误导某人
words.ex: Bad friends can lead someone astray.
words.ex_cn: 坏朋友可能会误导某人。
words.en: To cause someone to believe something that is not true, or to cause someone to act in a way that is not correct or proper.

words.tr: phrase. 走入歧途；堕落；丢失；被盗
words.ex: He went astray after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后走上了歧途。
words.en: If someone goes astray, they no longer follow the right course of action or the right way of life.

words.tr: phrase. 成为……的受害者；受到……的伤害
words.ex: Many people fall victim to the lure of easy money.
words.ex_cn: 许多人成为轻松赚钱的诱惑的牺牲品。
words.en: If someone falls victim to something, they are harmed or killed by it, or they are affected by it in a bad way.

words.tr: phrase. 道德责任；道德义务；出于伦理必须去做的事
words.ex: It is a moral imperative to help those in need.
words.ex_cn: 帮助那些需要帮助的人是一种道德命令。
words.en: A moral imperative is a principle originating inside a person's mind that compels them to act. It is a kind of categorical imperative, as defined by Immanuel Kant. Kant held that moral imperatives apply universally to all rational beings.

words.tr: phrase. 道德义务；道义责任
words.ex: He felt a moral obligation to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有道德义务去帮助穷人。
words.en: A duty based on principles of right and wrong, rather than legal requirements.

words.tr: phrase. 社会良知；对社会问题的关注与责任感
words.ex: He has a strong social conscience and helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他有强烈的社会良知，帮助穷人。
words.en: A person's sense of responsibility for the welfare of society.

words.tr: phrase. 法律义务；法定责任
words.ex: Fulfilling legal obligations is essential for maintaining business integrity.
words.ex_cn: 履行法律义务对于维护商业诚信至关重要。
words.en: A legal obligation is a duty that is enforceable by law, requiring an individual or entity to perform or refrain from performing certain actions.

words.tr: v. 迫使某人做某事；迫使某人履行义务
words.ex: The law obliges parents to send their children to school.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使父母送孩子上学。

words.w: have a duty or obligation to do something
words.tr: v. 有责任或义务做某事
words.ex: You have a duty to help your classmates.
words.ex_cn: 你有责任帮助你的同学。

words.w: It is obligatory for someone to do something
words.tr: adj. 某人必须做某事；有义务做某事
words.ex: It is obligatory for students to wear uniforms.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须穿校服。

words.w: It is incumbent on someone to do something
words.tr: v. 某人有责任/义务做某事
words.ex: It is incumbent on parents to protect their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母有责任保护他们的孩子。

words.w: It is imperative to do something
words.tr: 必须做某事；有义务做某事；极其重要的是做某事
words.uk: ɪt ɪz ɪmˈpɛrətɪv tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɪt ɪz ɪmˈpɜːrətɪv tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: It is imperative to study hard if you want to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想通过考试，就必须努力学习。
words.en: It is absolutely necessary or urgent to perform a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 不受惩罚地进行；未被处罚
words.ex: He cheated on the test and went unpunished.
words.ex_cn: 他考试作弊，却没有受到惩罚。
words.en: To not be punished for a wrongdoing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做了某事（尤指坏事）而未受惩罚或未被发现
words.ex: He got away with cheating on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试作弊却没有被发现。
words.en: To manage to do something wrong or risky without being punished or criticized.

words.tr: vi. 在逃；未被抓获；广泛存在
v. 免除；不受……的约束；不必承担（某责任或义务）
v. 将某人绳之以法；使某人受到法律制裁
words.ex: The police brought the thief to justice.
words.ex_cn: 警察将小偷绳之以法。

words.w: be sentenced to N years in prison
words.tr: v. 被判处有期徒刑 n 年
phrase. 对……负责；因……而被追究责任
words.ex: Managers should be held accountable for their team's performance.
words.ex_cn: 经理应对其团队的表现负责。
words.en: To be required to accept responsibility for one's actions or decisions, especially in a position of authority.

words.tr: v. 把某人关进监狱
words.ex: The court put the thief in jail for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 法院因盗窃把小偷关进了监狱。

words.tr: phrase. 被处以重罚；被严厉罚款
words.ex: He was heavily fined for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 他因超速被重罚。
words.en: to be subjected to a substantial monetary penalty for an offense

words.tr: phrase. 一种经济上的处罚；指因违反规定或合同而需支付的罚款或财务处罚
words.ex: He paid a financial penalty for breaking the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规定支付了一笔经济罚款。
words.en: A monetary fine imposed as punishment.

words.tr: phrase. 充斥着……的；充满……的（通常指不好的事物）
words.ex: The city is rife with noise and pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市充满了噪音和污染。
words.en: to be full of or characterized by something, often something undesirable

words.tr: adj. 泛滥的；猖獗的；蔓生的
words.ex: Rumors are rampant in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 谣言在这个小镇上四处流传。
words.en: If you describe something bad, such as a crime or disease, as rampant, you mean that it is very common and is increasing in an uncontrolled way.

words.tr: n. 不道德行为；不法行为；
words.ex: The company was punished for its wrongdoing.
words.ex_cn: 该公司因其不道德行为受到了惩罚。
words.en: Wrongdoing refers to behavior that is morally or legally wrong.

words.tr: n. 恶劣行为；
words.ex: The boy was punished for his misdeed.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因他的恶劣行为而受到惩罚。
words.en: A misdeed is a wrong or illegal deed; a crime or sin.

words.tr: phrase. 做错事；做不道德的事；犯错误
words.ex: He did wrong when he took the money.
words.ex_cn: 他拿钱的时候做错了。
words.en: To act in a way that is morally or legally incorrect.

words.tr: phrase. 职业不当行为；渎职；违反职业道德的行为
words.ex: The doctor lost his license for professional misconduct.
words.ex_cn: 这位医生因职业不当行为被吊销了执照。
words.en: Improper or unethical behaviour by someone in a professional role.

words.tr: phrase. 守法公民；遵纪守法的市民
words.ex: Law-abiding citizens follow the rules and pay their taxes.
words.ex_cn: 守法公民遵守规则并缴税。
words.en: People who obey the laws of the land.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守；信守
words.ex: You must abide by the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守校规。
words.en: To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.

words.tr: phrase. 遵从；依照；服从于
words.ex: He left the room in obedience to his teacher's order.
words.ex_cn: 他遵照老师的命令离开了房间。
words.en: In compliance with or submission to the authority, guidance, or instruction of someone or something.

words.w: turn a blind eye to something
words.tr: v. 对某事视而不见；故意忽视
words.ex: The teacher turned a blind eye to the cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作弊行为视而不见。

words.w: turn a deaf ear to something
words.tr: v. 对某事充耳不闻；故意不理睬
words.ex: He turned a deaf ear to his mother's advice.
words.ex_cn: 他对母亲的建议充耳不闻。

words.tr: phrase. 青少年犯罪
words.ex: The city is trying to reduce juvenile delinquency with after-school programs.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正通过课后项目来减少青少年犯罪。
words.en: Juvenile delinquency refers to the participation in illegal behavior by minors (juveniles) who fall under a statutory age limit.

words.tr: phrase. 少年犯；未成年犯罪者
words.ex: The juvenile delinquent was sent to a reform school for rehabilitation.
words.ex_cn: 这名未成年犯罪者被送到了一所教养学校进行改造。
words.en: A juvenile delinquent is a young person, usually under the age of 18, who commits a crime.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 犯罪；犯错；做出违法行为
words.ex: He committed an offense last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯了罪。
words.en: To break a law or rule.

words.tr: v. 冒犯；触怒；得罪
words.ex: He offended the law by stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他偷窃触犯了法律。
words.en: If you offend someone, you upset or embarrass them by saying or doing something that they think is rude or insulting.

words.tr: adj. 违法的；违反法律的
words.ex: He faced punishment for law-breaking.
words.ex_cn: 他因违法而受到惩罚。
words.en: The act of committing a crime or violating the law.

words.tr: v. 为某事承担责任；承担责备
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个错误承担责任。

words.w: place or put or lay the blame on someone or something
words.tr: v. 把责任归咎于某人或某事
words.ex: They place the blame on the driver for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们把事故的责任归咎于司机。

words.tr: v. 把责任推给某人
words.ex: He tried to shift the blame onto his teammate.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把责任推给他的队友。

words.tr: v. 责任在于某人
words.ex: The blame lies with the driver for not stopping at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 责任在于司机没有在红灯前停下。

words.tr: v. 逃避责任；推卸责任
words.ex: He tries to shirk responsibility when things go wrong.
words.ex_cn: 当事情出错时，他试图逃避责任。

words.w: take or assume responsibility for doing something
words.tr: v. 承担做某事的责任
words.ex: He took responsibility for fixing the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了修理这台坏机器的责任。

words.tr: phrase. 利用漏洞（指巧妙地或不道德地使用法律或系统中的漏洞来获得优势）
words.ex: He tried to exploit a loophole in the tax law.
words.ex_cn: 他试图利用税法中的一个漏洞。
words.en: To take advantage of a gap or ambiguity in a rule or system for personal gain.

words.tr: phrase. 违抗法律；公然违犯法规
words.ex: He defied the law by driving too fast.
words.ex_cn: 他超速驾驶，违反了法律。
words.en: To openly resist or refuse to obey a law or authority.

words.tr: n. 某种事物的温床；（尤指不良事物）迅速滋生或发展的场所
words.ex: The old factory became a hotbed of crime.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧工厂成了犯罪的温床。

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.tr: 短语. 某事正在酝酿中；某种事情正在悄然发生
words.ex: Something is brewing in the office about a new project.
words.ex_cn: 办公室里正酝酿着一个新项目。

words.w: a deterrent to someone or something
words.tr: n. 对某人或某事的威慑；阻止因素
words.ex: The high fine is a deterrent to speeding.
words.ex_cn: 高额罚款是对超速的威慑。

words.tr: v. 阻止某人做某事；劝阻某人不做某事
words.ex: The heavy rain deterred him from going out.
words.ex_cn: 大雨阻止了他外出。

words.tr: phrase. 身体和心理的健康状态
words.ex: Exercise and sleep help physical and psychological well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼和睡眠有助于身心健康。
words.en: The state of being physically healthy and mentally/emotionally stable.

words.tr: phrase. 身体上和精神上；身心两方面
words.ex: He feels physically and mentally tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后感到身心俱疲。
words.en: Relating to both the body and the mind.

words.tr: adj. 身体健康或健康状况不佳
words.ex: He is in poor health after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场长期疾病后，他的身体状况不佳。

words.tr: phrase. 保持某人的健康（或体能状态）
words.ex: He runs every morning to maintain his fitness.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To keep one's body in good condition through regular exercise and healthy habits.

words.tr: phrase. 保持身材；维持健康状态；保持良好体型
words.ex: He runs every morning to keep in shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain physical fitness and a good bodily condition.

words.tr: phrase. 提高某人的健康水平；增强体质
words.ex: He runs every morning to improve his fitness.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以提高体能。
words.en: To enhance one's physical health and condition through exercise and lifestyle changes.

words.tr: phrase. 增强某人的体力；使某人恢复力量
words.ex: He runs every morning to build up his strength.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To develop or increase one's physical strength and muscular endurance gradually.

words.tr: adj. 注重健康的
words.ex: She is health-minded and eats vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 她注重健康，每天都吃蔬菜。

words.tr: phrase. 健康素养；指个人获取、理解、评估和应用健康信息以做出适当健康决策的能力
words.ex: She improved her health literacy by reading simple medical guides.
words.ex_cn: 她通过阅读简单的医学指南提高了健康素养。
words.en: Health literacy refers to the ability to obtain, read, understand, and use healthcare information to make appropriate health decisions and follow instructions for treatment.

words.tr: v. 损害；削弱；使受损
words.ex: Smoking can impair your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会损害你的肺。

words.tr: phrase. 视力受损；视觉障碍；视力减退
words.ex: He has impaired vision and needs glasses.
words.ex_cn: 他视力受损，需要戴眼镜。
words.en: A condition where the ability to see is reduced or limited.

words.w: be hazardous to someone or something
words.tr: v. 对某人或某物构成危险
phrase. 久坐不动的生活方式；指长时间坐着、缺乏身体活动的生活模式
words.ex: He has a sedentary lifestyle because he sits all day at work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为整天坐在办公室工作而过着久坐的生活方式。
words.en: A way of living that involves little physical activity, often characterized by sitting for long periods.

words.tr: phrase. 身体不活跃的；缺乏运动的；久坐不动的
words.ex: He is physically inactive because he sits all day.
words.ex_cn: 他整天坐着，身体不活动。
words.en: Characterized by a lack of regular physical activity or exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 身体活跃的；经常进行体育活动的
words.ex: He is physically active every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很活跃。
words.en: Engaging in physical activities that increase heart rate and promote health.

words.tr: adj. 归家的；返程的；朝向家的
words.ex: The old man is home-bound because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为生病而足不出户。
words.en: Confined to one's home, often due to illness, disability, or other circumstances.

words.tr: v. 被束缚在办公桌前；长期坐在办公桌前工作
n. 肥胖；肥胖症；
words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.tr: adj. 极肥胖的
words.ex: He is obese because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多垃圾食品而肥胖。
words.en: If someone is obese, they are extremely fat.

words.tr: v. 增重或减重
words.ex: He tried to gain or lose weight by eating less and exercising more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过少吃多运动来增重或减重。

words.w: live on a diet of something
words.tr: vi. 以某种东西为食；靠某种东西维持生活
words.ex: Pandas live on a diet of bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫以竹子为食。

words.tr: phrase. 均衡的饮食
words.ex: He eats a balanced diet to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃均衡的饮食以保持健康。
words.en: A diet that includes all the necessary nutrients in appropriate proportions for good health.

words.tr: v. 挡开；避开（某物）；防止（不好的事情发生）
words.ex: She used an umbrella to ward off the rain.
words.ex_cn: 她用伞挡开雨水。

words.tr: v. 保护以防止某事发生；防范某物
words.ex: Wear a helmet to safeguard against head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔以防止头部受伤。

words.tr: v. 抗击疾病；与疾病作斗争
words.ex: Doctors work hard to combat disease.
words.ex_cn: 医生们努力抗击疾病。

words.tr: v. 坚持；遵循； adhering to
words.ex: He stick to his plan even when it was hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他仍然坚持自己的计划。

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏睡眠
words.ex: He feels tired because of sleep deprivation.
words.ex_cn: 他因为睡眠不足而感到疲倦。
words.en: Sleep deprivation is the condition of not having enough sleep; it can be either chronic or acute.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 足够的睡眠；充足的休息
words.ex: He needs adequate sleep to feel good.
words.ex_cn: 他需要充足的睡眠来感觉良好。
words.en: Enough in amount, quality, or duration to meet a standard or need for rest.

words.tr: v. 打乱或扰乱某人的日常安排
words.ex: The storm disrupted her morning routine.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴打乱了她的早晨日常安排。

words.tr: phrase. 清醒的时间；醒着的时段
words.ex: She spends most of her waking hours at work.
words.ex_cn: 她大部分醒着的时间都在工作。
words.en: The period of time during which a person is awake and not asleep.

words.w: be susceptible to someone or something
words.tr: adj. 易受……影响的；对……敏感的；容易被……打动的

words.w: be vulnerable to someone or something
words.tr: adj. 易受...影响的；对...缺乏防护的；容易被...伤害或攻击的
adj. 倾向于；易于发生某事的
phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: n. 寿命；使用寿命；生命期；
words.ex: The lifespan of a housefly is only a few weeks.
words.ex_cn: 家蝇的寿命只有几周。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.tr: n. 长寿；寿命；
words.ex: Eating healthy food helps with longevity.
words.ex_cn: 健康饮食有助于长寿。
words.en: Longevity refers to the length or duration of an individual's life, especially when it is unusually long.

words.tr: phrase. 心境；心理状态；精神状况
words.ex: He is in a calm state of mind.
words.ex_cn: 他处于平静的心态中。
words.en: The condition of someone's mental state or mood at a particular time.

words.tr: n. 心理状态；
words.ex: His mentality changed after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他的心理状态发生了变化。
words.en: Your mentality is your attitudes and your way of thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 心态；精神状态；心理态度
words.ex: He has a positive mental attitude.
words.ex_cn: 他有积极的心态。
words.en: A person's habitual way of thinking, feeling, and behaving.

words.tr: phrase. 剧烈的运动；需要大量体力的体育活动
words.ex: He avoids strenuous sports because he has a weak heart.
words.ex_cn: 他避免剧烈运动，因为他心脏不好。
words.en: Requiring great physical effort and exertion; demanding sports.

words.tr: n. 枯竭；耗尽；筋疲力尽；
words.ex: The long hike led to his exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的徒步旅行导致他筋疲力尽。
words.en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.tr: n. 耐力；
words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.tr: 短语动词. 增强耐力；提高体力
words.ex: Regular exercise helps to build up stamina.
words.ex_cn: 定期锻炼有助于增强耐力。
words.en: To increase physical or mental endurance through practice or training.

words.tr: phrase. 有氧运动；指通过持续、有节奏的身体活动来增强心肺功能的锻炼方式，如跑步、游泳、骑自行车等
words.ex: He does aerobic exercise every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做有氧运动。
words.en: Physical activity that increases the heart rate and improves the body's use of oxygen, typically performed over a prolonged period.

words.tr: phrase. 燃烧卡路里，消耗热量
words.ex: He runs every morning to burn calories.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步来燃烧卡路里。
words.en: To burn calories means to use energy by doing physical activity, which can help in weight loss or maintaining a healthy weight.

words.tr: phrase. 体育赛事；运动项目比赛
words.ex: The city is hosting a major sports event next month.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市下个月将举办一场大型体育赛事。
words.en: A sports event is an organized competition or activity involving physical exertion and skill, typically involving teams or individuals competing against each other.

words.tr: phrase. 激烈的竞争；强劲的角逐
words.ex: There is fierce competition for the job.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Intense rivalry for limited opportunities or positions.

words.tr: phrase. 运动天赋；体育才能
words.ex: He has great athletic talent.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的运动天赋。
words.en: Natural aptitude or ability for physical sports or exercise.

words.tr: adj. 破纪录的
words.ex: The athlete's record-breaking performance won him a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: adj. 这位运动员破纪录的表现为他赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: Achieving a better performance or result than ever before.

words.tr: phrase. 发泄某人精力的途径；一种让人释放能量的方式
words.ex: Running is an outlet for one's energy.
words.ex_cn: 跑步是发泄精力的一种方式。
words.en: A means of releasing or expressing one's energy or emotions.

words.tr: phrase. 发泄情绪；宣泄精力；释放压力
words.ex: He runs every day to let off steam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步来发泄情绪。
words.en: If you let off steam, you get rid of your energy, anger, or strong emotions by doing something active or noisy.

words.tr: adj. 势均力敌的
words.ex: The two teams were evenly-matched, making the game very exciting.
words.ex_cn: adj. 两支队伍势均力敌，使得比赛非常精彩。
words.en: adj. If two people or teams are evenly-matched, they are equally strong or skilled.

words.tr: v. 支配某物；控制某物；在某物中占主导地位
words.ex: The big tree dominates the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这棵大树支配着整个花园。

words.tr: phrase. （尤指戏剧、电影或小说的）悬念结局，扣人心弦的结尾；令人焦急等待后续发展的情节
words.ex: The movie ended with a cliffhanger.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一个悬念结尾。
words.en: A suspenseful ending to a story or episode that leaves the audience eager to know what happens next.

words.tr: phrase. 可预测的；可预料的
words.ex: His behavior is predictable.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为是可以预测的。
words.en: To behave or occur in a way that can be foreseen or expected.

words.tr: n. 团队合作；
words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
