words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.tr: phrase. 团队精神
words.ex: The team showed great team spirit during the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛期间，团队展现了极强的团队精神。
words.en: Team spirit refers to the feelings of camaraderie and enthusiasm for the group that one is part of, especially in a sports team or workplace.

words.tr: n. 板球；蟋蟀
words.ex: He plays cricket every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友们打板球。
words.en: Cricket is a sport played between two teams of eleven players each, using a bat and ball, on a field with a wicket at each end.

words.tr: phrase. 赛马；跑马比赛
words.ex: Horse racing is a popular sport in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 赛马是许多国家的一项流行运动。
words.en: A sport in which horses race against each other, often with jockeys riding them.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的体育精神；指在比赛中表现出尊重、公平、谦虚和礼貌的态度
words.ex: He showed good sportsmanship after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在输掉比赛后展现了良好的体育精神。
words.en: Good sportsmanship refers to the ethical, appropriate, and polite behavior exhibited by participants in sports or other competitive activities.

words.tr: n. 足球流氓
words.ex: The police arrested some football hooligans after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛后，警察逮捕了一些足球流氓。

words.tr: phrase. 社交动物；喜欢与人交往的人
words.ex: Humans are social creatures.
words.ex_cn: 人类是社会性生物。
words.en: An animal or person that lives and interacts in groups, relying on social contact.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢社交的、外向的
phrase. 与某人交往；与某人社交互动
words.ex: He likes to socialize with his neighbors after work.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢下班后和邻居交往。

words.tr: phrase. 通信手段；交流方式；沟通工具
words.ex: Phones and emails are means of communication.
words.ex_cn: 电话和电子邮件是沟通的方式。
words.en: Means of communication refers to the methods or systems used for exchanging information or messages between people or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 沟通能力
words.ex: He improved his communication skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中提高了沟通技能。
words.en: Communication skills refer to the ability to convey information to another effectively and efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 充分参与；完全投入到
words.ex: He wants to participate fully in the class discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他想完全参与课堂讨论。
words.en: To take part in something completely or to the fullest extent.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；参与
words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 支持某人；对某人给予支持的
phrase. 志同道合的人
words.ex: When I met her, I knew immediately that she was a kindred spirit.
words.ex_cn: 当我遇到她时，我立刻知道她是一个志同道合的人。
words.en: A person whose interests or attitudes are similar to one's own.

words.tr: phrase. 相处；进展
words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.w: the complete opposite of someone or something
words.tr: phrase. 完全相反的人或事物
words.ex: He is the complete opposite of his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他是他哥哥的完全相反。

words.tr: 短语. 第一印象最持久
words.ex: First impressions are most lasting.
words.ex_cn: 第一印象最持久。
words.en: The initial perception or opinion formed about someone or something tends to have a lasting impact on subsequent judgments and relationships.

words.tr: 谚语. 诚实是最好的策略；做人应以诚实为上策
words.us: ˈɑːnəsti ɪz ðə bɛst ˈpɑːli si
words.ex: He always tells the truth because honesty is the best policy.
words.ex_cn: 他总是说真话，因为诚实是最好的策略。
words.en: A proverb advising that telling the truth is always the most advantageous course of action in the long run.

words.tr: 短语动词. 指彼此想法一致，理解相同，心意相通
words.ex: They are on the same wavelength and understand each other easily.
words.ex_cn: 他们想法一致，很容易理解对方。
words.en: To think in a similar way and to understand each other well.

words.w: don't see eye to eye with someone
words.tr: phrase. 与某人意见不一致；对某事看法不同
words.ex: I don't see eye to eye with my brother about money.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥在钱的问题上意见不一致。

words.tr: phrase. 只在顺境时才做朋友的人；不能共患难的朋友
words.ex: He is a fair-weather friend who leaves when things get hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个只在顺境时才陪伴的朋友，一有困难就离开。
words.en: A person who is only supportive or friendly in times of success or good fortune.

words.tr: v. 背后捅刀子；背叛某人
words.ex: He stabbed his friend in the back by telling the boss the lie.
words.ex_cn: 他通过告诉老板一个谎言，在背后捅了朋友一刀。

words.w: console someone at times of sorrow
words.tr: v. 在悲伤时刻安慰某人
words.ex: She console her friend at times of sorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她在朋友悲伤时安慰他。

words.tr: phrase. 欢乐与悲伤；人生的喜怒哀乐
words.ex: He feels the joys and sorrows of life every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天感受着生活的喜与悲。
words.en: The phrase 'joys and sorrows' refers to the happy and sad experiences that are part of life.

words.w: compete on a level playing field
words.tr: 短语. 在公平的条件下竞争；在平等的竞争环境中较量
words.uk: kəmˈpiːt ɒn ə ˈlev(ə)l ˈpleɪɪŋ fiːld
words.us: kəmˈpiːt ɑːn ə ˈlev(ə)l ˈpleɪɪŋ fiːld
words.ex: All companies should compete on a level playing field.
words.ex_cn: 所有公司都应在公平的环境中竞争。
words.en: To compete in a situation where everyone has an equal chance of winning or succeeding.

words.tr: phrase. 光明正大地；堂堂正正地
words.ex: He won the game fair and square.
words.ex_cn: 他公平合理地赢得了比赛。
words.en: If you say that someone won a competition fair and square, you mean that they won honestly and without cheating.

words.tr: n. 卫生；卫生学；
words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 烹饪用具；厨具
words.ex: She carefully selected the best cooking utensils for her new kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的新厨房精心挑选了最好的炊具。
words.en: Tools or containers used in the preparation of food.

words.tr: phrase. 有营养的；营养价值高的
words.ex: Eating vegetables can be nutritious for your health.
words.ex_cn: v. 吃蔬菜对你的健康是有营养的。
words.en: To be nutritious means to provide the substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的营养；合理的膳食
words.ex: He eats good nutrition to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃有营养的食物来保持健康。
words.en: A diet that provides all the necessary nutrients for health.

words.tr: v. 养肥（fatten 的现在分词）; adj. 使人发胖的；正被养肥的；用于养肥禽畜的
words.ex: Sugary snacks are fattening.
words.ex_cn: 甜点心容易让人发胖。
words.en: Making or becoming fat or fatter.

words.tr: 短语动词. 正当令的；正当时节的（指水果、蔬菜等在自然成熟的季节中，供应充足且价格较低）
words.ex: Strawberries are in season now, so they are cheaper.
words.ex_cn: v. 草莓现在正当时令，所以更便宜。
words.en: If a food is in season, it is the time of year when it is naturally available and ready to eat.

words.tr: 短语动词. 不在当季；过时的；不合时宜的
words.ex: The strawberries are out of season now.
words.ex_cn: 现在草莓不是应季的。
words.en: To be out of season means to be outside the usual time of year for a particular activity, product, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 食物供应；食品储备
words.ex: The storm damaged the food supplies.
words.ex_cn: 风暴破坏了食物补给。
words.en: Food supplies are the stocks of food available for consumption, especially in a household, community, or for emergencies.

words.tr: phrase. 速冻食品
words.ex: He bought some frozen food from the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 他从超市买了些速冻食品。
words.en: Frozen food refers to food that has been subjected to rapid freezing and is kept frozen until use, preserving it from the time of preparation to the time of consumption.

words.tr: phrase. 罐头食品
words.ex: He eats canned food for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃罐头食品。
words.en: Food that has been processed and sealed in a can or jar to preserve it.

words.tr: phrase. 电视餐；即食冷冻餐，通常在看电视时食用
words.ex: He ate a tv dinner while watching his favorite show.
words.ex_cn: 他一边看最喜欢的节目，一边吃电视餐。
words.en: A pre-packaged meal consisting of frozen food components that are heated before eating.

words.tr: n. 茶点；“refreshment”的复数；
words.ex: We served refreshments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议后我们提供了茶点。
words.en: Light snacks and drinks served to guests or participants at an event.

words.tr: phrase. 健康的饮食；有益健康的膳食
words.ex: Eating a wholesome diet helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的饮食有助于你保持健康。
words.en: A wholesome diet refers to a way of eating that contributes to overall health and well-being, typically including a variety of nutrients from different food groups.

words.tr: phrase. 不健康的饮食
words.ex: He has an unhealthy diet because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他饮食不健康，因为他吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: A pattern of eating that lacks essential nutrients and harms health.

words.tr: adj. 油污的；多油的；
words.ex: The greasy pan needed a good wash.
words.ex_cn: 这个油污的平底锅需要好好洗一洗。
words.en: Something that is greasy has a lot of grease or oil on it or in it.

words.tr: v. 减少；削减（某物的用量或开支）
words.ex: He decided to cut down on sugar to be healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他决定减少糖的摄入以更健康。

words.tr: n. 摄入量；
words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于快餐的人；快餐成瘾者
words.ex: He is a fast food junkie who eats burgers every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是个快餐迷，每天都吃汉堡。
words.en: A person who is very fond of or addicted to fast food.

words.tr: phrase. 碳酸饮料；含气饮料
words.ex: He drinks carbonated drinks every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都喝碳酸饮料。
words.en: Carbonated drinks are beverages that contain dissolved carbon dioxide gas, creating bubbles and a fizzy sensation.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯；指个人或群体在日常饮食中的偏好和规律
words.ex: His dietary habits changed after he got sick.
words.ex_cn: 他生病后，饮食习惯发生了变化。
words.en: Dietary habits are the regular patterns of eating and drinking that a person or group follows.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食失调
words.ex: He has an eating disorder and needs help.
words.ex_cn: 他有饮食失调，需要帮助。
words.en: An eating disorder is a mental disorder defined by abnormal eating habits that negatively affect a person's physical or mental health.

words.tr: phrase. 微量元素；痕量元素（指生物体或物质中含量极微但具有重要生理或化学作用的元素）
words.ex: Plants need trace elements to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要微量元素才能良好生长。
words.en: Trace elements are minerals required by the body in very small amounts for normal physiological functions.

words.tr: adj. 蛋白质丰富的
words.ex: Eggs are protein-rich foods.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋是富含蛋白质的食物。
words.en: Protein-rich describes food that contains a high amount of protein, a nutrient essential for building and repairing tissues.

words.tr: phrase. 爱吃甜品
words.ex: She has a sweet tooth and eats candy every day.
words.ex_cn: 她爱吃甜食，每天都要吃糖果。
words.en: If you have a sweet tooth, you like eating sweet foods, especially sweets and chocolate.

words.tr: phrase. 成为美食家；对美食有高雅品味的人
words.ex: He is a gourmet who loves fine cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱优质奶酪的美食家。
words.en: To have a refined and sophisticated taste in food and drink, often implying expertise and appreciation.

words.tr: phrase. 令人垂涎的
words.ex: The aroma of the freshly baked bread was mouth-watering.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜出炉的面包的香气令人垂涎。
words.en: If you describe food as mouth-watering, you mean that it looks or smells extremely delicious.

words.tr: phrase. 令人作呕的；令人厌恶的；极不愉快的
words.ex: The smell from the trash is disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾的气味很恶心。
words.en: To cause a strong feeling of disgust or revulsion, making someone feel physically or emotionally repelled.

words.tr: phrase. v. 变得过于兴奋或激动而失去控制；忘乎所以；得意忘形
words.ex: He got carried away with the game and forgot to eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他玩游戏玩得忘了吃晚饭。
words.en: If you get carried away, you are so excited or involved in something that you do something hasty or foolish.

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷静；保持镇定
words.ex: It's important to keep calm in stressful situations.
words.ex_cn: 在压力大的情况下保持冷静是很重要的。
words.en: To remain calm and not become agitated or upset.

words.tr: v. 热爱；崇拜某人或某物
words.ex: She adores her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她热爱她的小狗。

words.tr: phrase. 对……充满热情的；热爱……的
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于打篮球。
words.en: To have a very strong interest in or enthusiasm for something.

words.tr: adj. 热衷的；
words.ex: He is an avid reader of mystery novels.
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于阅读侦探小说。
words.en: If you say that someone is avid for something, you mean that they are very eager to get it.

words.tr: v. 渴望某物；对某物有强烈的渴望
words.ex: He has a yearning for adventure.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望冒险。

words.tr: v. 渴望某物；对某物有强烈的欲望
words.ex: I have a craving for chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 我渴望吃巧克力。

words.tr: v. 比某物更优秀；优于某物

words.w: be fond of someone or something
words.tr: v. 喜欢某人或某物；对某人或某物有好感
v. 非常喜欢某人或某物
words.ex: I quite like my new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我非常喜欢我的新老师。

words.tr: adj. 对某事漠不关心的；对某事无动于衷的
n. 偏好；
words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr: phrase. 关心；挂念
words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To be worried or anxious about something or someone.

words.tr: v. 不喜欢某人或某物
words.ex: I dislike the loud music at the party.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢派对上吵闹的音乐。

words.w: have a strong aversion to someone or something
words.tr: v. 对某人或某事有强烈的反感
words.ex: He has a strong aversion to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他對巨大的聲音有強烈的反感。

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事；对做某事感到犹豫或勉强
words.ex: He is reluctant to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意在全班面前说话。
words.en: Hesitate or be unwilling to perform a specific action.

words.tr: v. 无法忍受某人或某事
words.ex: I can't stand loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受巨大的噪音。

words.tr: v. 厌恶某物；憎恨某事
words.ex: I loathe eating spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 我厌恶吃辣的食物。

words.tr: v. 厌恶某人或某物
words.ex: I detest people who lie to others.
words.ex_cn: 我厌恶欺骗别人的人。

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: adv. 预先；提前；
words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.w: draw up a plan or a list
words.tr: v. 拟定计划或清单
words.ex: He drew up a plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他拟定了一个省钱的计划。

words.tr: phrase. 打算做某事；有意做某事
words.ex: I intend to do my homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我打算晚饭后做作业。
words.en: To have a plan or desire to perform an action.

words.w: have one's heart set on something
words.tr: v. 立志要做某事；一心想要某物
words.ex: He has his heart set on becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他立志要成为一名医生。

words.tr: phrase. 下决心；拿定主意
words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: v. 对某事感到矛盾；既喜欢又反感
words.ex: I have mixed feelings about moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 我对搬到新城市感到矛盾。

words.tr: v. 将决定某事
words.ex: The results will determine your future.
words.ex_cn: 这些结果将决定你的未来。

words.tr: phrase. 悬而未决的；不确定的
words.ex: The trip plans are still up in the air.
words.ex_cn: 旅行计划仍然未定。
words.en: If something is up in the air, it is uncertain and often because it has not been decided or agreed on.

words.w: someone is still wavering between... and
words.tr: 某人仍在……和……之间犹豫不决
words.ex: He is still wavering between taking the job and staying in school.
words.ex_cn: 他仍在接受这份工作和继续上学之间犹豫不决。

words.tr: v. 说服某人做某事
words.ex: He convinced his friend to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他说服了他的朋友加入这个俱乐部。

words.w: someone has no say in something
words.tr: v. 某人对某事没有发言权；某人无权参与决定
words.ex: The students have no say in the school's dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学生对学校的着装规定没有发言权。

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 徒劳的；白费的；没有结果的
words.ex: He tried to fix the car, but it was in vain.
words.ex_cn: 他试图修理汽车，但徒劳无功。
words.en: Without success or result; futile.

words.tr: phrase. 结出果实；产生结果；奏效
words.ex: If you work hard, your efforts will bear fruit.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力工作，你的努力会结出果实。
words.en: To produce a desired result or to become successful.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；
words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.tr: 谚语. 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆；自作自受
words.ex: If you work hard, you will succeed. You reap what you sow.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力工作，你就会成功。种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。
words.en: This phrase means that your actions, whether good or bad, will have consequences that you will eventually experience.

words.tr: phrase. 一个千载难逢的机会；极好的机会
words.ex: This is a golden opportunity to expand our business overseas.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个拓展海外业务的黄金机会。
words.en: An exceptionally favorable or advantageous chance that is rare and valuable.

words.tr: phrase. 抓住机会
words.ex: He decided to seize the opportunity to study abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他决定抓住机会去国外学习。
words.en: To take advantage of a chance to do something.

words.tr: phrase. (事情)付诸东流，白白浪费，化为乌有
words.ex: All his hard work went down the drain when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，所有的努力都白费了。
words.en: If something goes down the drain, it is wasted or fails to achieve anything.

words.tr: phrase. 尽力；努力；使自己付出努力
words.ex: He exerts himself to finish the job on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力按时完成工作。
words.en: To exert oneself means to make a physical or mental effort.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 专心致志；努力投入（工作或任务）
words.ex: He applies himself to his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: To devote oneself diligently and persistently to a task or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 实现；成功；结出果实（指计划、想法等最终得以实现）
words.ex: Her dream to open a small bakery came to fruition last year.
words.ex_cn: 她开一家小面包店的梦想去年实现了。
words.en: If a plan or project comes to fruition, it is successfully completed after a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 被抛弃；中途放弃；逐渐被遗忘或失败
words.ex: He promised to exercise daily, but his plan fell by the wayside after a week.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺每天锻炼，但一周后这个计划就放弃了。
words.en: Fail to continue with a task or plan, often due to difficulty or lack of commitment.

words.tr: phrase. 薄弱环节；最弱的一环
words.ex: The weak link in the chain broke easily.
words.ex_cn: 链条中最弱的一环很容易就断了。
words.en: A person or thing in a system that is weak and likely to cause failure.

words.w: The only fly in the ointment is
words.tr: 短语 只有的美中不足是
words.uk: ðə ˈəʊnli flaɪ ɪn ðə ˈɒntmənt ɪz
words.us: ðə ˈoʊnli flaɪ ɪn ðə ˈɑːntmənt ɪz
words.ex: The food was perfect; the only fly in the ointment is the slow service.
words.ex_cn: 食物很完美，唯一的美中不足是服务太慢。

words.tr: 短语动词. 对双方都有利或都有害；两面都有影响
words.ex: This rule can cut both ways: it helps some people but hurts others.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则可能两面都有影响：它帮助了一些人，但也伤害了其他人。
words.en: If something cuts both ways, it has both positive and negative effects or can be interpreted in two different ways.

words.tr: phrase. 一场灾难的征兆；注定失败的安排；可能导致严重后果的情况
words.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
words.ex_cn: n. 酒后驾驶是灾难的预兆。
words.en: A situation or course of action that is likely to lead to failure or disaster.

words.tr: adj. 一贯正确的；
words.ex: The pope is considered infallible in matters of faith by some Catholics.
words.ex_cn: 一些天主教徒认为教皇在信仰问题上是一贯正确的。
words.en: If a person or thing is infallible, they are never wrong or never fail.

words.tr: n. 传下来的衣物；二手衣物
words.ex: He wears hand-me-downs from his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他穿他哥哥传下来的衣服。
words.en: Clothes or other items that have been passed down from one person to another, typically within a family.

words.tr: phrase. 破烂的衣服；褴褛的衣衫
words.ex: The boy wore tattered clothing to school.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩穿着破烂的衣服去上学。
words.en: Clothing that is torn, worn, or in poor condition.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿着得体以获得成功，指通过穿着正式或专业的服装来提升个人形象和职业成就
words.ex: You should dress for success when going to a job interview.
words.ex_cn: 去参加工作面试时，你应该穿得得体以取得成功。
words.en: To dress in a way that is intended to create a positive impression and help achieve success, especially in a professional context.

words.tr: 短语动词. 穿着舒适的衣服；为了舒适而穿衣
words.ex: She dresses for comfort on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 她在周末穿得舒服。
words.en: Choose clothing that prioritizes ease and practicality over style.

words.w: someone has impeccable taste in clothing
words.tr: 某人穿着品味无可挑剔
words.ex: She always wears elegant clothes; someone has impeccable taste in clothing.
words.ex_cn: 她总是穿得优雅；某人穿着品味无可挑剔。

words.tr: phrase. 俗气的；廉价低档的（用于形容衣物）
words.ex: He wore tacky clothing to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着俗气的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Clothing that is considered cheap, tasteless, or in poor style.

words.tr: phrase. 人靠衣装；衣冠决定人的形象
words.ex: He wears a suit to work, because clothes make the man.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿西装，因为人靠衣装。
words.en: The idea that a person's appearance and clothing influence how others perceive their character or status.

words.tr: phrase. 便装；休闲服
words.ex: He wears casual clothes to the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末穿便服去公园。
words.en: Clothes designed for informal occasions, emphasizing comfort and ease of wear.

words.tr: phrase. 华丽的服装；正式场合穿的服饰
words.ex: He wears dressy clothes to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿正式衣服去参加婚礼。
words.en: Formal or smart attire suitable for special occasions.

words.tr: phrase. 优雅的服装；雅致的服饰
words.ex: She wears elegant clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿优雅的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Clothing that is stylish, refined, and of high quality.

words.tr: adj. 赶时髦的
words.ex: She is fashion-conscious and always wears trendy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她很注重时尚，总是穿流行的衣服。
words.en: Someone who is fashion-conscious is very interested in fashion and wants to wear the latest styles.

words.tr: phrase. 时尚牺牲品；指盲目追随潮流、穿着打扮显得可笑或不协调的人
words.ex: She often becomes a fashion victim, buying clothes that are trendy but not suitable for her.
words.ex_cn: 她经常成为盲目追求时尚的受害者，购买那些流行但不适合她的衣服。
words.en: A person who slavishly follows fashion trends, often to an excessive or unflattering degree.

words.tr: phrase. 透气的衣物；指能让空气和湿气通过的服装材料，常用于运动服或户外服装
words.ex: He wears breathable clothing to stay cool.
words.ex_cn: 他穿透气的衣服来保持凉爽。
words.en: Clothing that allows air to pass through it, making it comfortable to wear, especially in hot weather or during physical activity.

words.tr: phrase. 防水的衣服；能防止水渗透的服装
words.ex: He wore waterproof clothes to stay dry in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着防水衣服以在雨中保持干燥。
words.en: Garments designed to repel water and keep the wearer dry in wet conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 多感官体验
words.ex: The museum offers a multi-sensory experience with sounds, smells, and touchable objects.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆提供包含声音、气味和可触摸物品的多感官体验。

words.tr: adj. （事物或处所）没有生气的; 呆板的; 乏味的; （人）不懂感情的
words.ex: The movie felt soulless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影感觉没有灵魂，很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as soulless, you mean that they lack human qualities and the ability to feel or produce deep feelings.

words.tr: n. 有读写能力；识字；
words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr: phrase. 潦草的笔迹；凌乱的字迹
words.ex: His messy handwriting makes it hard to read the note.
words.ex_cn: 他凌乱的字迹让这张便条很难读懂。
words.en: Handwriting that is untidy and difficult to read.

words.tr: n. 书法；笔迹
words.ex: He practices calligraphy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习书法。
words.en: Calligraphy is the art of producing decorative handwriting or lettering with a pen or brush.

words.tr: phrase. 避免打字错误；防止拼写错误
words.ex: She tries to avoid typos in her emails.
words.ex_cn: 她努力在邮件中避免拼写错误。
words.en: To prevent mistakes in writing or typing.

words.tr: phrase. 有声读物；音频书
words.ex: He listens to an audio book on his way to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班路上听有声书。
words.en: An audio book is a recording of a book or other work being read out loud. A reading of the complete text is described as 'unabridged', while readings of a shorter version are 'abridged'.

words.tr: phrase. 可用收益；可支配收入；税后收入
words.ex: He uses his disposable income to buy books.
words.ex_cn: 他用可支配收入买书。
words.en: Disposable income is the amount of money that households have available for spending and saving after income taxes have been accounted for.

words.tr: phrase. 炫耀性消费；挥霍
words.ex: He buys expensive cars for conspicuous consumption.
words.ex_cn: 他买昂贵的汽车是为了炫耀性消费。
words.en: Conspicuous consumption refers to the act of buying and using products to publicly display economic power—of the income or of the accumulated wealth of the buyer.

words.tr: phrase. 对…征税；向…课税
words.ex: The government decided to levy a tax on luxury goods.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定对奢侈品征税。
words.en: To impose a tax on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 节约的；经济的；节省的
words.ex: He tries to be economical with water.
words.ex_cn: 他努力节约用水。
words.en: To use resources carefully and avoid waste.

words.tr: phrase. 具有成本效益的；划算的；性价比高的
words.ex: Buying in bulk is cost-effective.
words.ex_cn: 批量购买很划算。
words.en: To provide good value for the money spent; efficient in terms of cost.

words.tr: phrase. 小处精明而大处浪费的；贪小便宜吃大亏的
words.ex: He saves pennies on groceries but spends a fortune on useless gadgets.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货上省小钱，却在无用的小玩意上花大钱。
words.en: Being careful with small amounts of money while being wasteful with large amounts, leading to greater overall loss.

words.tr: phrase. 收入来源
words.ex: Her small bakery is a source of income.
words.ex_cn: 她的小面包店是一个收入来源。
words.en: A means of earning money to support oneself.

words.w: scrimp and save to do something
words.tr: v. 勒紧裤腰带，省吃俭用以做某事
words.ex: They scrimp and save to buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 他们省吃俭用以买一套房子。

words.tr: v. 属于某人
words.ex: This book belongs to Tom.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于汤姆。

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 没钱的；破产的；手头紧的
words.ex: He is broke after buying a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一部新手机后身无分文。
words.en: To have no money; to be financially ruined.

words.tr: phrase. 赤贫；一贫如洗
words.ex: He lives in abject poverty with no food or shelter.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在极度贫困中，没有食物和住所。
words.en: Abject poverty refers to the most severe and degraded level of poverty, where individuals lack the means to meet the most basic needs for survival.

words.tr: phrase. 生活成本；生活费用
words.ex: The cost of living is high in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 大城市的物价很高。
words.en: The cost of living refers to the amount of money needed to sustain a certain standard of living by affording basic expenses such as housing, food, taxes, and healthcare.

words.tr: phrase. 生活标准；生活水平
words.ex: His job improved the standard of living for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作改善了家人的生活水平。
words.en: The level of wealth, comfort, material goods, and necessities available to a certain socioeconomic class or a certain geographic area.

words.tr: n. 收据；收条；
words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.tr: v. 花费某人一大笔钱；使某人付出巨额代价
words.ex: Buying that car cost him a fortune.
words.ex_cn: 买那辆车花掉了他一大笔钱。

words.tr: adj. ...的账单贵得离谱；费用极其昂贵
words.ex: The bill for the hotel stay is exorbitant.
words.ex_cn: 酒店住宿的账单贵得离谱。

words.tr: phrase. 高得令人望而却步的价格；高得难以承受的价格
words.ex: The new phone has prohibitively high prices for most people.
words.ex_cn: 这款新手机的价格对大多数人来说高得令人望而却步。
words.en: Prices that are so high that they prevent people from buying or doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的；不收费的
words.ex: The museum is free of charge on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆在星期天免费开放。
words.en: Provided without payment; costing nothing.

words.tr: phrase. 发大财；赚大钱；积累巨额财富
words.ex: He made a fortune by selling his small business.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖掉自己的小生意发了一笔财。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money, often in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 富人与穷人；有产者与无产者（常用于描述社会经济地位的两极分化）
words.ex: The haves and the have-nots often live in different neighborhoods.
words.ex_cn: 有产者和无产者常常住在不同的社区。
words.en: The phrase 'the haves and the have-nots' refers to the division between people who are wealthy and those who are not.

words.tr: phrase. 积累财富；积聚财产
words.ex: People work hard to accumulate wealth over time.
words.ex_cn: 人们努力工作以随时间积累财富。
words.en: Gradually increase the amount of money and assets one possesses over time through saving, investment, or other means.

words.tr: phrase. 地位象征；表示社会地位的标志
words.ex: He bought a luxury car as a status symbol.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆豪华车作为身份的象征。
words.en: An object or possession that signifies wealth or high social standing.

words.tr: phrase. 奢侈品；高档消费品
words.ex: She bought luxury goods for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为自己生日买了奢侈品。
words.en: Luxury goods are products that are not essential but are highly desired and associated with wealthy or affluent lifestyles. They are often of high quality and price.

words.tr: n. 商品；货物；日用品；
words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.tr: phrase. 贪得的；渴望获得的；有占有欲的
words.ex: He is acquisitive and always wants more things.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪得无厌，总是想要更多东西。
words.en: Wanting to have and keep a lot of possessions, especially in a way that seems selfish or greedy.

words.tr: n. 虚荣；自负
words.ex: He bought a new mirror because of his vanity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为虚荣心买了一面新镜子。
words.en: The quality of being vain; excessive pride in or admiration of one's own appearance or achievements.

words.tr: phrase. 节衣缩食；勒紧裤带（指削减开支、过更节俭的生活）
words.ex: When money is short, we have to tighten our belt.
words.ex_cn: 当钱不够时，我们必须勒紧裤腰带。
words.en: To reduce one's spending; to be more economical.

words.w: do something on a shoe string
words.tr: v. 用极少的钱或资源做某事；节衣缩食地做某事
words.ex: They opened a restaurant on a shoe string.
words.ex_cn: 他们用极少的钱开了一家餐厅。

words.tr: v. 付不起某物的费用；承担不起某事
words.ex: I cannot afford a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我付不起一部新手机的费用。

words.tr: v. 超出某人的经济能力；负担不起
phrase. 非常便宜的；廉价得惊人
words.ex: This phone is dirt-cheap at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这手机在市场上便宜得要命。
words.en: extremely inexpensive

words.tr: phrase. 便宜货；交易；契约
words.ex: This shirt is a bargain at $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫五美元，太值了。
words.en: An agreement to buy or sell something at a fixed price.

words.tr: phrase. 被低估的；未被充分重视的
words.ex: His talent is undervalued by his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的才华被老板低估了。
words.en: To be valued at less than something is truly worth.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去疯狂购物；进行一次购物狂欢
words.ex: She went on a shopping spree last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 她上个周末疯狂购物了一番。
words.en: To go on a shopping spree means to shop excessively and often impulsively, typically in a short period of time.

words.tr: n. 橱窗购物
words.ex: He enjoys window-shopping on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末逛橱窗。
words.en: The activity of looking at goods displayed in shop windows, especially without intending to buy anything.

words.tr: v. 跟踪；留意；记录某事
words.ex: Can you keep track of the homework assignments?
words.ex_cn: 你能跟踪作业任务吗？

words.tr: v. 无法追踪某物；失去对某物的联系或关注
words.ex: I lost track of my keys after I came home.
words.ex_cn: 我回家后就找不到我的钥匙了。

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏；不足；达不到（目标）；不符合
words.ex: They fall short of their goal every time.
words.ex_cn: 他们每次都没能达到目标。
words.en: To fail to reach a desired standard, level, or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 未能达到某人的期望
words.ex: He fell short of his parents' expectations.
words.ex_cn: 他未能达到父母的期望。

words.w: Only... won't balk at this price
words.tr: 只有... 不会拒绝这个价格
words.ex: Only rich people won't balk at this price.
words.ex_cn: 只有富人不会拒绝这个价格。

words.tr: phrase. 价格过高的；让人望而却步的
words.ex: The prohibitive price of the car made it unaffordable for most people.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的高昂价格让大多数人望而却步。
words.en: A prohibitive price is a price that is so high that it prevents people from buying something or doing something.

words.tr: v. 窥视；渴望得到（某物）；垂涎
words.ex: He covets his neighbor's new car.
words.ex_cn: 他觊觎邻居的新车。

words.tr: v. 嫉妒某人；羡慕某人
words.ex: He envies someone who has a big house.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒拥有大房子的人。

words.tr: phrase. 财务支持；经济援助
words.ex: He got financial support from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济支持。
words.en: Financial support refers to the provision of money or resources to help someone or something, especially in the context of education, business, or personal needs.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.tr: phrase. 财务问题；金融议题
words.ex: He has a financial issue with his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他在房租上遇到了经济问题。
words.en: A problem or difficulty relating to money, finance, or economic management.

words.tr: phrase. （在物质或社会地位上）与邻居或他人攀比；赶时髦
words.ex: They buy a new car every year just to keep up with the Joneses.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年买一辆新车，只是为了和邻居攀比。
words.en: To strive to match or surpass one's neighbors or peers in terms of material possessions or social status.

words.tr: phrase. 同伴压力；同辈压力
words.ex: He gave in to peer pressure and smoked cigarettes.
words.ex_cn: 他屈服于同龄人的压力，抽了香烟。
words.en: Influence from members of one's peer group.

words.tr: phrase. 乐器
words.ex: He plays musical instruments every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上演奏乐器。
words.en: Musical instruments are devices created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.tr: phrase. 有音乐天赋的；对音乐感兴趣的；在音乐方面有倾向的
words.ex: He is musically-inclined and plays the guitar well.
words.ex_cn: 他有音乐天赋，吉他弹得很好。
words.en: Having a natural ability or interest in music.

words.tr: phrase. 五音不全；不会唱歌；无法准确地唱出旋律
words.ex: She loves to sing, but she can't carry a tune.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢唱歌，但她无法唱准音调。
words.en: If someone can't carry a tune, they are unable to sing in a way that sounds good or correct.

words.tr: phrase. 音盲的；对音调不敏感的；无法辨别音高的
phrase. 充满…的；深受…影响的；浸透在…中的
words.ex: He is steeped in classical music.
words.ex_cn: 他深受古典音乐的熏陶。
words.en: To be deeply immersed in or saturated with a particular quality or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 原声音乐；不使用电子扩音或电子乐器的音乐，通常指用原声乐器演奏的音乐
words.ex: He plays acoustic music on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末演奏原声音乐。
words.en: Music that is produced by acoustic instruments without electronic amplification.

words.tr: n. 电台或电视台的播放
words.ex: The song gets a lot of airplay on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在广播中播放很多。
words.en: The broadcasting of songs or programs on radio or television.

words.tr: phrase. 流行音乐排行榜
words.ex: The song reached number one on the pop chart.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌登上了流行音乐排行榜榜首。
words.en: A list of the most popular songs or albums at a particular time, typically based on sales or radio play.

words.tr: phrase. 最畅销的专辑
words.ex: Thriller is the best-selling album of all time.
words.ex_cn: 《Thriller》是有史以来最畅销的专辑。

words.tr: phrase. 露天音乐会；户外音乐会
words.ex: They enjoyed an open-air concert under the stars.
words.ex_cn: 他们在星空下享受了一场露天音乐会。
words.en: An open-air concert is a musical performance that takes place outdoors, often in a park or other natural setting.

words.tr: phrase. 交响乐团
words.ex: The symphony orchestra played loudly at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 交响乐团在音乐会上大声演奏。
words.en: A symphony orchestra is a large orchestra that plays classical music and is led by a conductor.

words.tr: phrase. 刺耳的音乐；响亮刺耳的乐声
words.ex: The blaring music woke up the baby.
words.ex_cn: 刺耳的音乐把婴儿吵醒了。
words.en: Loud, harsh, and unpleasantly loud music.

words.tr: phrase. 充满，洋溢（常用于情感或光线等抽象事物）
words.ex: The room was suffused with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 房间里充满了阳光。
words.en: If something such as a book, film, or piece of music is suffused with a particular quality, that quality spreads all through it and is very noticeable in it.

words.w: be just another flash in the pan
words.tr: v. 只不过是昙花一现的又一个例子；不过是短暂的辉煌，很快就会消失
phrase. 大获成功的事物；极受欢迎的人或作品
words.ex: The movie was a smash hit, earning millions in its first weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影大获成功，首周末就赚了数百万美元。
words.en: A thing, especially a film, song, or show, that is very popular and successful.

words.tr: 短语动词. 具备成功所需的品质或能力；有本事，有能耐
words.ex: He works hard every day because he wants to have what it takes to be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力学习，因为他想具备成为一名医生所需要的素质。
words.en: To have the necessary qualities or abilities to succeed in a particular endeavor.

words.tr: n.假日游客
words.ex: Many holidaymakers visit the beach in summer.
words.ex_cn: 许多度假者在夏天去海滩。
words.en: People who are on holiday, especially those who are away from home.

words.tr: phrase. 预订航班
words.ex: She decided to book a flight to Paris for her vacation.
words.ex_cn: 她决定为她的假期预订一张去巴黎的机票。
words.en: To arrange and secure a seat on an airplane for a specific journey, typically through an airline or travel agent.

words.tr: phrase. 蜂拥至…；涌进（向）…
words.ex: Tourists flock to the beach in summer.
words.ex_cn: 游客在夏天涌向海滩。
words.en: If people flock to a place or event, they go there in large numbers because it is interesting or attractive.

words.tr: phrase. 带薪休假；带薪假期
words.ex: He got a paid holiday last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天得到了有薪假期。
words.en: Paid time off from work granted to an employee, often for vacation, personal reasons, or public holidays.

words.tr: n. 背包客
words.ex: The backpacker walked through the mountains with a big bag.
words.ex_cn: 那个背包客背着一个大包穿越了山脉。
words.en: A backpacker is someone who travels or hikes carrying their belongings in a backpack.

words.tr: n. 纪念品；纪念物；
words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr: v. 展览；陈列；展示；
words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.tr: n. 商品；货物；日用品；
words.ex: Wheat is a basic commodity in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 小麦在许多国家是一种基本商品。
words.en: A commodity is something that is bought and sold.

words.tr: adj. 商业化的； v. “commercialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old village became commercialized with many shops and tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的村庄因众多商店和游客而变得商业化。
words.en: If something is commercialized, it is used or changed in such a way that it makes money or profits, often in a way that people disapprove of.

words.w: make someone more tolerant and open-minded
words.tr: v. 使某人更加宽容和开明
words.ex: Traveling abroad can make someone more tolerant and open-minded.
words.ex_cn: 出国旅行可以使某人更加宽容和开明。

words.tr: phrase. 旅行社
words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.tr: phrase. 跟团旅行
words.ex: We booked a package tour to Japan last month.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个月预订了一次去日本的跟团旅行。
words.en: A package tour is a holiday organized by a travel agent, with arrangements for transport, accommodation, and sometimes meals and entertainment, all included in the price.

words.tr: phrase. 旺季
words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in peak season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when demand for a particular product or service is at its highest.

words.tr: phrase. 淡季
words.ex: The shop is quiet during the slack season.
words.ex_cn: 在淡季，商店很安静。
words.en: A period of time when business or activity is less busy than usual.

words.tr: phrase. 喷气式客机
words.ex: The jet airliner flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式客机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet airliner is a large aircraft powered by jet engines, designed to carry passengers on commercial flights.

words.tr: phrase. 飞行时差反应；时差感
words.ex: He feels tired because of jet lag.
words.ex_cn: 他因为时差而感到疲倦。
words.en: A temporary disorder that causes fatigue, insomnia, and other symptoms as a result of rapid travel across several time zones.

words.tr: 短语动词. 令人开眼界的；使人突然意识到真相或现实的
words.ex: The documentary was an eye-opener about poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片关于贫困的内容令人震惊。
words.en: To provide a surprising or enlightening experience that changes one's perspective.

words.tr: phrase. 消除先入之见；去除偏见或预先形成的观念
words.ex: Try to eliminate preconceptions when you meet new people.
words.ex_cn: 当你遇见新人时，试着消除先入之见。
words.en: To remove or get rid of preconceived ideas or opinions.

words.tr: 短语动词. 确认某人的偏见；使某人原有的偏见更加根深蒂固
words.ex: He only reads news that confirms his prejudices.
words.ex_cn: 他只阅读那些证实他偏见的新闻。
words.en: To strengthen one's existing beliefs or opinions, often by ignoring contradictory evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 缓解紧张；减轻压力
words.ex: She sings to ease tension after work.
words.ex_cn: 她唱歌来缓解工作后的紧张。
words.en: Reduce feelings of hostility or nervousness between people or in a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 深化相互理解
words.ex: Cultural exchanges can deepen mutual understanding between countries.
words.ex_cn: 文化交流可以深化国家之间的相互理解。
words.en: To enhance the level of understanding between parties involved.

words.tr: 被认作是冒犯性的；被认为具有冒犯意味的
words.ex: That joke is considered to be offensive by many people.
words.ex_cn: 很多人认为这个笑话是冒犯性的。
words.en: Be regarded as insulting, disrespectful, or hurtful to others.

words.tr: 短语动词. 产生税收收入
words.ex: The new store will generate tax revenue for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这家新商店将为城市产生税收收入。
words.en: Produce income for the government through taxes.

words.tr: phrase. 招致额外费用；产生额外成本
words.ex: He incurred additional costs by buying extra parts.
words.ex_cn: 他因为购买了额外的零件而产生了额外费用。
words.en: Bring about extra expenses or financial burdens.

words.tr: phrase. 游览胜地
words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.tr: phrase. 旅游目的地；旅游景点
words.ex: Paris is a popular tourist destination.
words.ex_cn: 巴黎是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。
words.en: A tourist destination is a place that attracts tourists due to its cultural, historical, or natural significance.

words.tr: 短语动词. 出发；上路；开始旅行
words.ex: He hit the road early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早上路以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to leave a place to go somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 留在原地；逗留不走
words.ex: He decided to stick around until the meeting was over.
words.ex_cn: 他决定留下来直到会议结束。
words.en: To remain in a place or situation, especially while waiting for something to happen or someone to arrive.

words.tr: phrase. 离开常规路线；探索人迹罕至之地；尝试非传统或冒险的事物
words.ex: They decided to venture off the beaten path to find a quiet beach.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定离开常规路线，去找一个安静的海滩。
words.en: To take a risk by doing something different or unusual, especially in travel or exploration.

words.w: be in the middle of nowhere
words.tr: phrase. 处于荒无人烟的地方；位于偏僻遥远之处
words.uk: biː ɪn ðə ˈmɪdl əv ˈnəʊhwɛər
words.us: biː ɪn ðə ˈmɪdl əv ˈnoʊhwɛr
words.ex: The cabin is be in the middle of nowhere, far from any town.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋位于荒无人烟的地方，远离任何城镇。
words.en: In a very remote or isolated place, far from towns or civilization.

words.tr: n. 路线；
words.ex: We planned our itinerary before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行前规划了路线。
words.en: An itinerary is a plan of a journey, including the route and the places that you will visit.

words.tr: n. 行李
words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.tr: phrase. 轻装上阵；轻装旅行
words.ex: He travels light with just a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他只带一个背包轻装旅行。
words.en: To travel with minimal luggage or belongings, making movement and exploration easier.
